t: Sit or stand tall with a neutral spine and relaxed shoulders. | Bring your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position, fingers pointing up. | Press your palms firmly into each other so your wrists feel a gentle stretch. | Slowly lower your joined hands toward your waist, keeping your palms pressed together and your elbows lifting outward. | Stop when you feel a comfortable stretch through your wrists and forearms, without any sharp pain. | Hold the position and breathe slowly and evenly, letting the stretch deepen with each exhale. | Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then release your hands back to chest height. | Repeat for 2 to 3 rounds, easing a little deeper only as the tissue loosens.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides and your core lightly braced. | Lift one knee to march in place, planting that foot back down softly through the ball of the foot. | Step in place with the other foot, settling into a steady, controlled marching rhythm. | As you step, raise both arms out and up toward overhead, keeping a slight bend in the elbows. | Lower your arms back to your sides in time with your steps, staying smooth rather than swinging. | Keep your chest up and your gaze forward, breathing steadily throughout. | Continue marching and raising your arms for the set duration, then slow your steps to come to a controlled stop.

t: Stand tall with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and your toes pointing forward. | Raise both arms out to the sides at shoulder height so they are spread wide apart, palms facing down. | Brace your core lightly and keep a tall chest as you begin to hinge forward at the hips. | Sweep one hand down and across your body in a smooth circular arc to reach toward the opposite foot or toe. | Let your torso rotate naturally with the reach while the trailing arm lifts up behind you. | Reach only as far as your flexibility allows, feeling a gentle stretch through the hips, waist, and hamstrings. | Reverse the arc to return to the tall, arms-wide starting position under control. | Repeat on the other side, alternating hands toward the opposite toe for your set.

t: Stand facing or beside a sturdy support at roughly shoulder to chest height, such as a squat rack, doorframe, or railing. | Place one or both hands flat on the support, keeping your arms close to straight without locking the elbows hard. | Set your feet a comfortable step back from the support and keep your core lightly braced. | Slowly shift your bodyweight away from the support so your upper arms and the front of your shoulders begin to lengthen. | Ease into the stretch until you feel a gentle, comfortable pull through the upper arms and shoulders, not pain. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and evenly, keeping your shoulders down and relaxed. | Release by stepping back toward the support, then switch sides or repeat for 2–3 total holds.

t: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs straight, the tops of your feet on the floor, and your arms extended overhead so your body forms a long line. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, then lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor into a Superman hold. | Keep your neck neutral by looking down at the mat, holding the back-extended position throughout the movement. | With your arms still raised, sweep them out and around in a wide arc from overhead toward your hips, keeping them off the floor the whole way. | Pause briefly with your arms by your sides, maintaining the lifted chest and legs. | Reverse the arc, sweeping your arms back overhead without letting them or your legs drop. | Continue sweeping the arms "around the world" for the desired reps, breathing steadily. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the floor under control to finish the set.

t: Set the seat height so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke, then sit upright with a tall, braced torso. | Place your feet on the pedals and strap them in if the bike has foot cages, keeping your heels down. | Grip the moving handles with a neutral hold, arms relaxed and elbows slightly bent. | Begin pushing and pulling the handles while driving the pedals, coordinating opposite arm and leg so the motion stays smooth. | Settle into a sustainable cadence for steady-state work, breathing in a steady rhythm with the effort. | For intervals, accelerate hard for the work period, driving aggressively through both handles and pedals to spin the fan faster. | Ease off to an easy spin during each recovery period instead of stopping fully, keeping the legs and arms moving. | When the session is done, slow the cadence gradually and let the fan wind down before stepping off.

t: Step onto the curved deck and grip the handrails for balance as you find your footing near the top of the curve. | Begin walking by driving one foot back against the belt, letting the curve pull the deck under you to set it in motion. | Build into a run by leaning slightly forward from the ankles and increasing your stride rate so the belt accelerates. | Stay tall through your torso, keep your gaze forward, and drive your knees forward with a relaxed, rhythmic arm swing. | Land midfoot under your hips and push the belt back with each step rather than reaching out in front of you. | Control your speed by moving toward the front of the curve to go faster and stepping back toward the flatter rear to slow down. | Settle your breathing into a steady rhythm, matching your pace to your target effort for the interval or steady run. | To finish, gradually shorten your stride and slow the belt to a walk, then grip the handrails and step off once it stops.

nE: Band Alternate Incline Chest Press with Twist
nR: Попеременный жим на наклонной с эспандером со скруткой
nH: לחיצת חזה בשיפוע לסירוגין עם גומייה בפיתול
t: Anchor the band securely behind you at about lower-back height and face away from the anchor, holding one handle in each hand. | Step forward to remove slack, then stagger or set your feet shoulder-width apart for a stable base. | Bring both hands up to chest level with your elbows bent and pointed down and back, palms facing forward. | Press one hand up and forward on an incline angle, aiming toward eye level rather than straight ahead. | As that arm extends, rotate your torso toward the opposite side so your obliques drive the twist. | Pause briefly with the arm near full extension, feeling the contraction in your upper chest. | Return under control to the start, untwisting your torso as the hand comes back to chest level. | Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for your target reps while keeping your hips square and core braced.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy point above head height and grab one handle in each hand. | Step or kneel back until you feel light tension, then stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your core braced. | Start with both arms extended overhead and a slight bend in your elbows. | Pull one handle down toward your hip, driving your elbow down and back while keeping the opposite arm extended overhead. | As you pull, rotate your torso toward the working side, twisting through your obliques while keeping your hips facing forward. | Squeeze your lat and feel your shoulder blade pull down and back at the bottom of the rep. | Reverse the motion under control, returning the handle and your torso to the starting position. | Repeat on the opposite side, alternating arms for the prescribed number of reps. | Finish your set, then step toward the anchor to release the band tension safely.

t: Anchor the band low behind you, near floor level, and hold one handle in each hand with your palms facing forward. | Step forward to take up the slack, stagger your feet for balance, and brace your core with a slight forward lean from the hips. | Start with both arms down and slightly out to your sides, elbows softly bent and locked at that angle throughout. | Sweep one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder in a wide arc, squeezing the lower chest at the top. | Pause briefly at the top with the working hand near chest height, feeling the contraction in the lower-chest fibers. | Lower that arm under control back to the starting position without letting the band snap you back. | Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the full set while keeping the non-working arm stable. | After your last rep, control the band back to the anchor and release the tension safely.

t: Anchor a resistance band at or near floor level and stand or sit facing the anchor, holding one handle in each hand with your arms extended toward it. | Step back to take the slack out of the band, then hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back, soft knees, and a braced core. | Set your shoulders down and back so the work starts from your mid-back, not your hands. | Drive one elbow back along your side, pulling the handle toward your hip and squeezing your shoulder blade in toward your spine. | As you row, rotate your torso open toward the working side to add the twist, keeping your hips stable. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbow behind your torso, then return the handle under control as you twist back to center. | Repeat the row and twist with the other arm, alternating sides for the full set. | After your last rep, step forward to release the band tension safely.

t: Loop a resistance band over the pull-up bar and pull the loose end down through itself to anchor it securely. | Grip the bar with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. | Place one foot or knee into the bottom of the band, then step off and let it stretch to support part of your bodyweight. | Hang at full extension with your arms straight and shoulder blades engaged, keeping your core braced and body still. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your back muscles rather than your arms. | Continue until your chin clears the bar, squeezing your lats and lower traps at the top. | Lower yourself under control back to a full dead hang, resisting the band's upward pull the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then carefully remove your foot from the band and step down.

t: Loop a resistance band over the chin-up bar and pull the bottom of the band down so it hangs in the centre. | Grip the bar with an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. | Place one knee into the bottom of the band so it supports part of your bodyweight, then hang with your arms fully extended. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back to set your starting position. | Pull your body up by driving your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar. | Squeeze your lats and biceps briefly at the top without swinging or kicking off the band. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended and your shoulder blades reset. | Complete your reps, then carefully remove your knee from the band and step down.

t: Loop a resistance band across the two dip bars so it forms a sling, or hook it to one bar and pull it across — a thicker band removes more body weight and gives more assistance. | Kneel or place your feet into the band so it supports you, then grip the bars with your palms facing in and your arms locked out, supporting your body at the top. | Pull your shoulders down and back, brace your core, and keep a slight forward lean to involve the chest or stay upright to bias the triceps. | Bend your elbows to lower your body under control until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows tracking close to your sides. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your shoulders shrug up toward your ears. | Press through your palms and extend your elbows to drive back up to the locked-out start position, letting the band help you through the sticking point. | Complete your reps, then step or lift out of the band and lower yourself off the bars under control.

t: Loop a resistance band across both dip bars so it spans the gap, then test that it holds your weight when you press down on it. | Grip the parallel bars with your palms facing in and press up to lock out your arms, supporting yourself at the top. | Place your knees (or feet) into the band so it cradles your lower body and takes part of your weight. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and let your shoulders sit down and back away from your ears. | Bend your elbows to lower your body under control until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Keep your elbows tracking back at a slight angle rather than flaring wide out to the sides. | Press through your palms to drive back up to a full lockout, squeezing your triceps at the top. | Complete your reps, then step or lift out of the band and bring your feet back to the floor with control.

nE: Band Assisted Floor Glute Ham Raise
nR: Подъём корпуса с эспандером от пола
t: Kneel on a soft pad with your knees together and your ankles anchored under a fixed surface, partner, or loaded support so your feet cannot lift. | Loop a resistance band around your chest or upper arms and anchor it to a sturdy point in front of you at roughly torso height to provide upward assistance. | Set your hips fully extended so your knees, hips, and shoulders form a straight line, and brace your core and squeeze your glutes. | Lower your torso toward the floor slowly and under control, letting your knees act as the hinge while you keep your body straight. | Resist the descent with your hamstrings as far as you can, then catch yourself lightly with your hands just before your chest reaches the floor. | Drive back up by contracting your hamstrings and glutes, using the band's tension to help pull your torso upright. | Return to the fully extended kneeling position with a straight line from knees to shoulders, then begin the next rep. | Complete your reps, then carefully unloop the band and release your ankles.

t: Loop a resistance band over a pull-up bar and pull the bottom of the loop down so you can place one foot or both knees into it. | Reach up and take a false grip on the bar, hooking your wrists over the top so your palms face roughly down and the bar sits on the heel of your hand. | Step or kneel into the band and hang at full stretch with your shoulders engaged, letting the band support part of your bodyweight. | Pull explosively, driving your elbows down and back to bring your chest toward the bar while the band assists the upward drive. | As your chest reaches the bar, lean forward over it and roll your shoulders ahead of your hands to begin the transition. | Press down through your hands and straighten your arms to push your torso up and over the bar into the support position. | Lower under control by reversing the motion: shift back, drop your chest below the bar, and return to a dead hang. | Complete your reps, then carefully step out of the band and lower to the floor.

t: Anchor one end of the band to a stable post or have a partner hold it, then loop the other end around your waist or hold it at hip height. | Walk forward until the band has light tension and take up your sprint start position with one foot staggered behind the other. | Lean your torso forward from the ankles, brace your core, and pull your elbows to roughly 90 degrees. | Drive off the back foot and accelerate forward, punching your knees up and pumping your arms front-to-back in time with your legs. | Keep your steps short and powerful through the first few strides, staying low and pushing against (or driving with) the band's tension. | Continue sprinting for the set distance or time, keeping your foot strikes under your hips and your head and neck relaxed. | Decelerate smoothly under control rather than stopping abruptly, letting the band slacken as you slow. | Walk back to the start, reset the band tension, and repeat for your planned number of rounds.

t: Anchor a resistance band at a high point, well above head height, and kneel on the leg nearest the anchor with the other foot planted flat in front of you. | Grip the band with both hands and bring them up toward the high anchor, keeping your arms long and your torso tall. | Brace your core, square your hips and shoulders, and tuck your ribs down before you move. | Pull the band down and across your body in a diagonal line toward your front hip, leading with your trailing-side shoulder. | Finish with your hands just outside your front hip, keeping your arms mostly straight and your back flat. | Pause briefly at the bottom while resisting the band's pull, keeping your spine stacked. | Return your hands along the same diagonal path under control until you reach the high start position. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch your kneeling leg and repeat in the opposite direction.

tHe: עגן גומייה בנקודה גבוהה, הרבה מעל גובה הראש, וכרע על הרגל הקרובה לעוגן כשהרגל השנייה נטועה שטוחה לפניך. | Grip the band with both hands and bring them up toward the high anchor, keeping your arms long and your torso tall. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, ישר את המותניים והכתפיים, וכופף את הצלעות כלפי מטה לפני שתתחיל לנוע. | Pull the band down and across your body in a diagonal line toward your front hip, leading with your trailing-side shoulder. | Finish with your hands just outside your front hip, keeping your arms mostly straight and your back flat. | Pause briefly at the bottom while resisting the band's pull, keeping your spine stacked. | Return your hands along the same diagonal path under control until you reach the high start position. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch your kneeling leg and repeat in the opposite direction.

t: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with feet about shoulder-width apart for an even, stable base. | Hold one end of the band in each hand with a neutral grip — palms facing each other, thumbs pointing up. | Let your arms hang straight down at your sides with your elbows pinned close to your torso. | Brace your core and keep your shoulders back, then curl both hands up toward your shoulders, keeping your palms facing inward throughout. | Squeeze the forearms and biceps at the top, keeping your wrists straight and elbows still. | Lower the hands under control back to the starting position, resisting the band's pull rather than letting it snap down. | Complete your reps, then step off the band carefully to release the tension.

t: Anchor a resistance band securely above head height — over a door, a high rack peg, or a pull-up bar — so the line of pull comes from above and behind you. | Stand facing away from the anchor with a band handle in each hand and take a staggered stance for balance. | Step forward until the band is taut, then raise your arms out to the sides and slightly above shoulder height with a soft bend in the elbows. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades back and down to set a stable base. | Sweep both hands down and forward in a wide arc, bringing them together in front of your lower chest while squeezing your pecs. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the arc, focusing on the contraction in your chest. | Reverse the motion under control, letting your arms travel back up and out until you feel a controlled stretch across the chest. | Complete your reps, then step back toward the anchor to safely release the tension.

nE: Band High Knee Lunge with Single Arm Row
nR: Выпад с высоким коленом + тяга одной рукой с эспандером
nH: מכרע ברך גבוהה + חתירה ביד אחת עם גומייה
t: Anchor the band securely at roughly chest height in front of you and hold the free end in one hand, stepping back until the band has light tension. | Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, core braced, and your working arm extended toward the anchor. | Step back into a lunge on the same side as your working arm, lowering until both knees bend to about 90 degrees. | As you drive back up, pull the band toward your ribs by leading with your elbow, keeping it close to your torso. | At the top, drive that same knee up high in front of you into a balanced high-knee position while the band stays rowed in. | Control the return: lower the knee and extend the arm back toward the anchor under tension. | Repeat for your set reps at a steady, rhythmic pace, then switch the band to the other hand and work the opposite side.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте груди перед собой и возьмите свободный конец одной рукой, отойдя назад до лёгкого натяжения. | Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, core braced, and your working arm extended toward the anchor. | Step back into a lunge on the same side as your working arm, lowering until both knees bend to about 90 degrees. | Поднимаясь обратно, потяните эспандер к рёбрам, ведя движение локтем и держа его близко к корпусу. | Вверху высоко поднимите то же колено перед собой в балансе высокого колена, удерживая эспандер в тяге. | Контролируйте возврат: опустите колено и разогните руку назад в сторону амортизатора под натяжением. | Repeat for your set reps at a steady, rhythmic pace, then switch the band to the other hand and work the opposite side.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה היטב בערך בגובה החזה מולך ואחוז בקצה החופשי ביד אחת, תוך צעידה לאחור עד למתח קל. | Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, core braced, and your working arm extended toward the anchor. | Step back into a lunge on the same side as your working arm, lowering until both knees bend to about 90 degrees. | בעלייה בחזרה, משוך את הגומייה לעבר הצלעות בהובלת המרפק, תוך שמירה עליו קרוב לגו. | בשיא הרם את אותה ברך גבוה לפניך לעמדת ברך גבוהה מאוזנת כשהגומייה נשארת משוכה פנימה. | Control the return: lower the knee and extend the arm back toward the anchor under tension. | Repeat for your set reps at a steady, rhythmic pace, then switch the band to the other hand and work the opposite side.

t: Loop a resistance band around both legs, positioning it just above your ankles or around your knees for more tension. | Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, weight on one leg, and place your hands on your hips or hold a wall for balance. | Brace your core and keep your hips level and facing forward throughout the movement. | Keeping the working leg straight, push it out to the side against the band's resistance. | Raise the leg as far as you can while keeping your torso upright and avoiding any lean to the opposite side. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction on the outside of your hip. | Lower the leg back to the start under control, resisting the band rather than letting it snap your foot back. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.

t: Anchor one end of the resistance band to a sturdy fixed point at or near floor level, off to one side. | Loop the other end around the ankle of the leg closest to the anchor, then stand far enough away that the band has light tension. | Stand tall with your feet roughly hip-width apart, brace your core, and hold onto a wall or rack for balance. | Let the band pull the working leg outward, away from your standing leg, into a slight abducted position to set the starting stretch. | Keeping the working leg straight, pull it inward across your body toward and past the midline, squeezing your inner thigh. | Pause briefly at the end of the range when your inner-thigh muscles are fully contracted. | Return the leg slowly and under control to the starting position, resisting the band the whole way. | Complete all reps on one side, then turn around to switch the anchor side and repeat with the other leg.

t: Anchor one end of the resistance band to a low, sturdy point in front of you and loop the other end around your working ankle. | Face the anchor and step back until the band is taut, then hold a wall or rack for balance and shift your weight onto your standing leg. | Brace your core and set a slight bend in your standing knee, keeping your back flat and chest tall. | Squeeze your glute and drive the working leg straight back, extending at the hip while keeping the knee only slightly bent. | Continue until your thigh is in line with or just behind your torso, pausing briefly to feel the glute contract. | Lower the leg under control back toward the anchor, resisting the band rather than letting it snap your leg forward. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the band to the other ankle and repeat.

tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מלפניך ולפף את הקצה השני סביב קרסול הרגל העובדת. | Face the anchor and step back until the band is taut, then hold a wall or rack for balance and shift your weight onto your standing leg. | הדק את הליבה וקבע כיפוף קל בברך העומדת, תוך שמירה על גב שטוח וחזה גבוה. | Squeeze your glute and drive the working leg straight back, extending at the hip while keeping the knee only slightly bent. | Continue until your thigh is in line with or just behind your torso, pausing briefly to feel the glute contract. | Lower the leg under control back toward the anchor, resisting the band rather than letting it snap your leg forward. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז העבר את הגומייה לקרסול השני וחזור על התרגיל.

nR: Горизонтальные сгибания на бицепс с эспандером
t: Anchor the resistance band at roughly chest height and stand facing the anchor point. | Grip a handle in each hand with your palms facing up and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended out in front of you. | Set your upper arms parallel to the floor, level with your shoulders, and keep your elbows fixed in that horizontal position. | Brace your core and keep your torso upright without leaning back or swinging. | Curl the handles toward your face by bending only at the elbows, squeezing the biceps as your hands approach your head. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping your upper arms horizontal and stationary. | Lower the handles back to the extended position under control, resisting the band the whole way. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release tension and set the band down.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте груди и встаньте лицом к креплению. | Grip a handle in each hand with your palms facing up and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended out in front of you. | Set your upper arms parallel to the floor, level with your shoulders, and keep your elbows fixed in that horizontal position. | Напрягите корпус и держите корпус вертикально, не отклоняясь назад и не раскачиваясь. | Поднимите рукояти к лицу, сгибая только локти, сжимая бицепс, когда кисти приближаются к голове. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping your upper arms horizontal and stationary. | Lower the handles back to the extended position under control, resisting the band the whole way. | Выполните свои повторения, затем подойдите к якорю, чтобы ослабить натяжение и положить эспандер.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה בערך בגובה החזה ועמוד מול נקודת העיגון. | Grip a handle in each hand with your palms facing up and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended out in front of you. | Set your upper arms parallel to the floor, level with your shoulders, and keep your elbows fixed in that horizontal position. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גו זקוף בלי להישען לאחור או להתנדנד. | Curl the handles toward your face by bending only at the elbows, squeezing the biceps as your hands approach your head. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping your upper arms horizontal and stationary. | Lower the handles back to the extended position under control, resisting the band the whole way. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release tension and set the band down.

nE: Band horizontal Pallof Press with Resistance Band Squat
nR: Горизонтальный жим Паллофа с приседом с эспандером
nH: לחיצת פאלוף אופקית עם סקוואט גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band at chest height to a sturdy upright on your side, then step away until the band is taut and turn so the anchor is directly to your left or right. | Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and clasp the band handle with both hands, holding it against the center of your chest. | Brace your core, square your hips and shoulders to the front, and set a slight outward rotation through your knees and feet. | Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up. | Hold the bottom of the squat and press the band straight out in front of you until your arms are fully extended, resisting the band's pull toward the anchor. | Pause for a beat with arms extended, keeping your hips, shoulders, and the band perfectly square to the front. | Draw the band back to your chest under control without letting your torso twist toward the anchor. | Drive through your heels to stand back up out of the squat, then complete your reps and repeat facing the opposite direction.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер на высоте груди за прочную стойку сбоку, затем отойдите до натяжения эспандера и развернитесь так, чтобы опора оказалась строго слева или справа. | Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and clasp the band handle with both hands, holding it against the center of your chest. | Напрягите корпус, выровняйте бёдра и плечи по отношению к переду и установите небольшое наружное вращение в коленях и стопах. | Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up. | Hold the bottom of the squat and press the band straight out in front of you until your arms are fully extended, resisting the band's pull toward the anchor. | Pause for a beat with arms extended, keeping your hips, shoulders, and the band perfectly square to the front. | Подтяните эспандер к груди под контролем, не позволяя вашему корпусу скручиваться к точке крепления. | Отталкивайтесь пятками, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение из приседа, затем выполните все повторения и повторите, повернувшись в противоположную сторону.
tHe: עגן גומייה בגובה החזה לזקיף יציב בצד שלך, ואז התרחק עד שהגומייה מתוחה והסתובב כך שהעוגן בדיוק לשמאלך או לימינך. | Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and clasp the band handle with both hands, holding it against the center of your chest. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, ישר את המותניים והכתפיים לפנים, והגדר סיבוב קל כלפי חוץ בברכים וברגליים. | Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up. | Hold the bottom of the squat and press the band straight out in front of you until your arms are fully extended, resisting the band's pull toward the anchor. | Pause for a beat with arms extended, keeping your hips, shoulders, and the band perfectly square to the front. | Draw the band back to your chest under control without letting your torso twist toward the anchor. | Drive through your heels to stand back up out of the squat, then complete your reps and repeat facing the opposite direction.

t: Anchor one end of the resistance band securely to a low, fixed point in front of you, such as the base of a rack or a sturdy post. | Hold the free end of the band against your chest or loop it behind your neck, then step back until the band is under light tension. | Hinge forward at your hips to bring your torso toward the floor, keeping a slight bend in your knees and your spine in a long, neutral line. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to begin the movement, feeling the band resist as you start to rise. | Extend your torso upward by driving your hips forward until your back, hips, and shoulders form a straight line. | Pause briefly at the top and contract your glutes and lower back without arching past neutral. | Lower your torso back down under control, resisting the band as you return to the hinged starting position. | Complete your reps, then step forward to release the band tension safely.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите один конец эспандера в низкой фиксированной точке перед собой, например к основанию рамы или прочной стойке. | Hold the free end of the band against your chest or loop it behind your neck, then step back until the band is under light tension. | Hinge forward at your hips to bring your torso toward the floor, keeping a slight bend in your knees and your spine in a long, neutral line. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы начать движение, ощущая сопротивление эспандера при подъёме. | Extend your torso upward by driving your hips forward until your back, hips, and shoulders form a straight line. | Pause briefly at the top and contract your glutes and lower back without arching past neutral. | Lower your torso back down under control, resisting the band as you return to the hinged starting position. | Выполните повторения, затем шагните вперёд, чтобы безопасно снять натяжение эспандера.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה היטב לנקודה נמוכה וקבועה מלפניך, למשל בסיס המתקן או עמוד יציב. | Hold the free end of the band against your chest or loop it behind your neck, then step back until the band is under light tension. | Hinge forward at your hips to bring your torso toward the floor, keeping a slight bend in your knees and your spine in a long, neutral line. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כדי להתחיל את התנועה, תוך הרגשת התנגדות הגומייה כשאתה מתחיל לעלות. | Extend your torso upward by driving your hips forward until your back, hips, and shoulders form a straight line. | Pause briefly at the top and contract your glutes and lower back without arching past neutral. | Lower your torso back down under control, resisting the band as you return to the hinged starting position. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד קדימה כדי לשחרר את מתח הגומייה בבטחה.

t: Anchor the band low and behind you — under your feet, around a low fixed point, or behind a bench set to a 30–45° incline. | Sit back against the incline (or stand in a staggered stance leaning slightly back) and take a handle in each hand, palms facing forward. | Bring your hands to the front of your shoulders, elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, and pull your shoulder blades down and together. | Brace your core and set the band so there is tension before you start the press, with no slack in the line. | Press the handles up and forward along the incline angle until your arms are fully extended without locking out hard. | Squeeze your upper chest at the top, keeping your wrists stacked over your forearms. | Lower the handles under control back to the front of your shoulders, resisting the band the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the anchor or release the band tension safely with control.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер низко позади вас — под стопами, вокруг низкой фиксированной точки или позади скамьи с наклоном 30–45°. | Sit back against the incline (or stand in a staggered stance leaning slightly back) and take a handle in each hand, palms facing forward. | Переместите руки перед собой до уровня плеч, локти прижты к корпусу под углом примерно 45°, и опустите лопатки вниз и вместе. | Напрягите корпус и натяните эспандер так, чтобы перед началом жима уже было напряжение, без слабины. | Press the handles up and forward along the incline angle until your arms are fully extended without locking out hard. | Squeeze your upper chest at the top, keeping your wrists stacked over your forearms. | Lower the handles under control back to the front of your shoulders, resisting the band the whole way down. | Выполните свои повторения, затем сойдите с якоря или безопасно контролируйте ослабление натяжения эспандера.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה נמוך ומאחוריך – מתחת לכפות הרגליים, סביב נקודה נמוכה וקבועה, או מאחורי ספסל בזווית 30–45°. | Sit back against the incline (or stand in a staggered stance leaning slightly back) and take a handle in each hand, palms facing forward. | הבא את ידיך לקדמת הכתפיים, מרפיים צמודות בזווית של כ-45° לגוף, ומשוך את שלפוחיות הכתף למטה וקרוב זו לזו. | הדק את הליבה ומקם את הגומייה כך שיהיה מתח לפני תחילת הלחיצה, ללא רפיון. | Press the handles up and forward along the incline angle until your arms are fully extended without locking out hard. | Squeeze your upper chest at the top, keeping your wrists stacked over your forearms. | Lower the handles under control back to the front of your shoulders, resisting the band the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the anchor or release the band tension safely with control.

nE: Band Jump Lunge with Single Arm Row
nR: Выпады в прыжке + тяга одной рукой с эспандером
nH: מכרעים בקפיצה + חתירה ביד אחת עם גומייה
t: Anchor the band at about chest height and grip the handle in one hand, stepping back until the band is taut. | Drop into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot back, both knees bent toward 90 degrees and your torso upright. | Brace your core and pull the band handle to the side of your ribs, driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade. | Extend the working arm to let the band return under control as you prepare to jump. | Push explosively through both legs and jump straight up, switching your feet in the air. | Land softly into a split stance on the opposite leg, absorbing the impact through bent knees. | Repeat the row on each landing, keeping a smooth, continuous pace for your target reps. | Finish your set, then ease the band back to the anchor under control.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте груди и возьмите рукоять одной рукой, отойдя назад, пока эспандер не натянется. | Примите положение выпада с одной ногой впереди и другой сзади, оба колена согнуты под углом примерно 90 градусов, корпус прямой. | Напрягите корпус и подтяните рукоять эспандера к боковой стороне рёбер, отводя локоть назад и сводя лопатку. | Extend the working arm to let the band return under control as you prepare to jump. | Push explosively through both legs and jump straight up, switching your feet in the air. | Land softly into a split stance on the opposite leg, absorbing the impact through bent knees. | Repeat the row on each landing, keeping a smooth, continuous pace for your target reps. | Finish your set, then ease the band back to the anchor under control.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה בערך בגובה החזה ואחוז בידית ביד אחת, תוך צעידה לאחור עד שהגומייה מתוחה. | Drop into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot back, both knees bent toward 90 degrees and your torso upright. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את ידית הגומייה לצד הצלעות, תוך דחיפת המרפק לאחור וכיווץ השכמה. | Extend the working arm to let the band return under control as you prepare to jump. | Push explosively through both legs and jump straight up, switching your feet in the air. | Land softly into a split stance on the opposite leg, absorbing the impact through bent knees. | Repeat the row on each landing, keeping a smooth, continuous pace for your target reps. | Finish your set, then ease the band back to the anchor under control.

t: Anchor the band under your foot or to a low fixed point, then hold the free end in one hand. | Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, keeping a flat back and a slight bend in your knees. | Pin your working upper arm tight against your side so it stays parallel to your torso throughout the set. | Start with your elbow bent at about 90°, taking up any slack so the band is already under light tension. | Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight and your triceps is fully contracted, keeping the upper arm still. | Squeeze the triceps briefly at full extension without swinging or letting the band yank your arm. | Lower under control by bending the elbow back to the 90° start position, resisting the band on the way in. | Complete your reps on one arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tRu: Зафиксируйте эспандер под стопой или к низкой фиксированной точке, затем возьмите свободный конец одной рукой. | Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, keeping a flat back and a slight bend in your knees. | Pin your working upper arm tight against your side so it stays parallel to your torso throughout the set. | Start with your elbow bent at about 90°, taking up any slack so the band is already under light tension. | Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight and your triceps is fully contracted, keeping the upper arm still. | Squeeze the triceps briefly at full extension without swinging or letting the band yank your arm. | Lower under control by bending the elbow back to the 90° start position, resisting the band on the way in. | Выполните повторения на одну руку, затем поменяйте сторону и повторите.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה מתחת לכף הרגל או לנקודה נמוכה וקבועה, ואז אחוז בקצה החופשי ביד אחת. | Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, keeping a flat back and a slight bend in your knees. | Pin your working upper arm tight against your side so it stays parallel to your torso throughout the set. | Start with your elbow bent at about 90°, taking up any slack so the band is already under light tension. | Extend your elbow back until your arm is straight and your triceps is fully contracted, keeping the upper arm still. | Squeeze the triceps briefly at full extension without swinging or letting the band yank your arm. | Lower under control by bending the elbow back to the 90° start position, resisting the band on the way in. | בצע את החזרות שלך בזרוע אחת, ואז החלף צדדים וחזור על התרגיל.

nH: כפיפות בטן על הברכיים עם גומייה
t: Anchor the resistance band securely to a high point above your head, such as a sturdy bar, door anchor, or rack. | Kneel on the floor facing or just in front of the anchor, and grip the band with both hands. | Pull the band down so your hands sit beside your head or behind your neck, keeping a slight bend at the hips. | Brace your core and set a tall, neutral spine before you begin the rep. | Crunch your torso down by contracting your abs, drawing your ribcage toward your pelvis and rounding your upper back. | Lower until you feel a strong contraction in your abdominals, keeping your hips fixed in place. | Slowly reverse the movement under control, letting the band pull you back up until your spine is tall again. | Complete your reps, then release the band tension under control and detach it from the anchor.

nH: כפיפות בטן על הברכיים עם גומייה (גרסה 2)
t: Anchor a resistance band to a high point above and behind you, such as the top of a cable frame or a sturdy pull-up bar. | Kneel on a mat facing away from the anchor and reach back to grasp the band ends, holding them at the sides of your head or just behind your neck. | Walk forward or settle into position until you feel constant tension on the band, with your hips stacked over your knees and your spine tall. | Brace your core and exhale as you crunch your rib cage down toward your pelvis, rounding your upper back against the band's resistance. | Pause briefly at the bottom when your abdominals are fully contracted, keeping your hips fixed in place. | Inhale and reverse the movement under control, letting the band draw your torso back up to the tall starting position without losing tension. | Complete your reps, then carefully release the band tension and unhook it from the anchor.

nH: משיכה עליונה על הברכיים עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band securely to a fixed point above your head, such as a pull-up bar or a high door anchor. | Grip the band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, palms facing forward. | Kneel down on the floor under the anchor with your hips stacked over your knees and your torso tall. | Brace your core, draw your shoulder blades down and back, and start with your arms extended overhead under light band tension. | Pull the band down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your lats rather than your hands. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom and keep your chest lifted as the band reaches chest level. | Pause briefly, then let the band rise back overhead under control until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then release the band tension slowly before unhooking it.

t: Kneel behind a preacher bench and step or kneel on the middle of the band so it is anchored under your knees or feet. | Hold a handle or the band itself in each hand with an underhand (palms-up) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Drape the backs of your upper arms over the angled preacher pad, keeping your armpits high against the top of the pad. | Let the band pull your arms toward a near-full extension, keeping a slight bend in the elbows to maintain tension. | Curl your hands up toward your shoulders by flexing the elbows, keeping your upper arms flat on the pad. | Squeeze the biceps at the top, then lower under control against the band's pull back to the starting stretch. | Complete your reps, then carefully step off the band to release the tension.

t: Anchor the band securely at roughly chest height — around a power-rack upright, a door anchor, or a fixed post — and grab one handle in each hand. | Step back until the band is taut with your arms extended in front of you, then set your feet shoulder-width apart with knees slightly bent. | Brace your core, keep your back flat and straight, and stand tall with your chest up and shoulders down. | Pull the handles toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows straight back, leading with the elbows rather than the hands. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull and hold for a beat, keeping your wrists neutral. | Return the handles forward under control, resisting the band as your arms straighten and your shoulder blades spread apart. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release the band tension safely.

t: Anchor the band under your feet or to a low fixed point, then hold the bar with both hands at arm's length in front of your thighs. | Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, knees soft, chest up, and shoulder blades set down and back. | Hinge at the hips by pushing your glutes back, letting the bar travel down and back between your thighs while keeping your spine neutral. | Drive your hips forward explosively, squeezing your glutes hard to snap the bar upward as the band tension peaks. | Let the momentum float the bar up to about chest height with your arms relatively straight, bracing your core and keeping your shoulders down. | Control the bar back down by hinging at the hips again, absorbing the band's pull rather than fighting it with your arms. | Continue swinging for the prescribed reps in a smooth, rhythmic cadence, then set the bar down under control.

nE: Barbell Complex - Stiff Leg Deadlift - Clean - Step
nR: Комплекс со штангой: становая на прямых ногах, взятие, шаг
nH: קומפלקס עם מוט: דדליפט ברגליים ישרות, הנפה, צעד
t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, the barbell over your mid-foot, and grip it just outside your thighs with a double-overhand grip. | Brace your core, keep your back flat, and hinge at the hips with only a slight knee bend, lowering the bar along your legs until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. | Drive your hips forward to stand tall and complete the stiff-leg deadlift, keeping the bar close to your body. | Without resetting, dip slightly at the hips and knees, then explosively extend through your hips, ankles, and knees to pull the bar upward. | As the bar rises, pull yourself under it and catch it across the front of your shoulders in a clean, elbows high and core braced. | From the catch, step forward into a controlled stride, keeping your torso upright and the bar secure on your shoulders. | Recover your step to a standing position, then lower the bar under control back to the floor to begin the next rep or finish the set.

t: Set the barbell in a rack at about upper-chest height and load it with an appropriate weight. | Step under the bar and rest it across your upper back (on the traps), gripping it slightly wider than shoulder-width with your wrists stacked over the bar. | Unrack the bar by standing tall, then step back into a stance roughly shoulder-width apart with your toes turned slightly out. | Take a deep breath, brace your core hard, and keep your chest up and back flat throughout the rep. | Lower yourself by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, descending until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and your weight spread across your whole foot. | Drive through your feet and extend your hips and knees to stand back up, keeping your core braced. | Complete your reps, then step forward and re-rack the bar safely with control.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly soft. | Grip the barbell shoulder-width apart with an underhand (palms-up) grip, arms hanging straight down. | Brace your core and pin your upper arms against your sides so your elbows stay fixed. | Curl the bar up toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows, keeping your wrists straight and neutral. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top without swinging your torso or letting your elbows drift forward. | Lower the bar under control over 2–3 seconds until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then set the bar down safely with control.

t: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart and the bar resting against your thighs. | Brace your core and keep your elbows pinned to your sides as you curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top. | From the top of the curl, rotate your grip and press the bar overhead until your arms are fully extended, driving with your shoulders and triceps. | Keep your upper arms beside your head and lower the bar behind your neck under control by bending only at the elbows, stretching the triceps. | Extend your elbows to press the bar back up to the locked-out overhead position. | Reverse the press to return the bar to the front of your shoulders, then lower it back to your thighs with control. | Complete your reps, then set the bar down safely.

t: Set a barbell across your upper back (not your neck), resting it on your traps and gripping it slightly wider than shoulder-width. Unrack it and step back into an open space. | Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, brace your core, and keep your chest up and shoulders back. | Step one foot diagonally behind and across the other leg, as if performing a curtsey, planting the ball of the rear foot on the floor. | Bend both knees to lower under control until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your rear knee drops toward the ground behind your front leg. | Keep your front knee tracking over your front foot and your torso upright, with most of your weight on the front heel. | Drive through your front heel to push back up to standing, returning the rear foot to the starting position. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat, or alternate sides each rep as programmed. | Once finished, step forward to the rack and re-rack the barbell safely under control.

t: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart, with the barbell over your mid-foot and your shins close to the bar. | Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Set your back flat and brace your core, pulling your chest up so your spine stays in a neutral position. | Take the slack out of the bar by pulling lightly upward until you feel tension, keeping your arms straight. | Drive through your mid-foot and extend your hips and knees together, dragging the bar close to your legs. | Stand tall at lockout by squeezing your glutes, with your hips and knees fully extended and your shoulders back. | Lower the bar under control by pushing your hips back first, then bending your knees to return it to the floor. | Reset your brace and position before each rep, then repeat or set the bar down to finish.

t: Load the barbell and hang a length of chain from each sleeve so the bulk of each chain rests on the floor when the bar is down. | Step up to the bar with feet about hip-width apart, mid-foot under the bar and shins close to it. | Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your knees with a double-overhand or mixed grip. | Set your back flat, brace your core, pull the slack out of the bar, and bring your chest up. | Drive your feet into the floor and stand the weight up, keeping the bar tight against your legs as more chain links peel off the floor and load the bar. | Finish standing tall with hips and knees fully extended, squeezing your glutes at the top without leaning back. | Lower the bar under control along the same path, letting the chains settle back onto the floor as you reach the bottom. | Reset your brace and position before each rep, then re-rack or unload the bar when the set is complete.

t: Set up a stable platform or stack of plates 1–4 inches high and stand on it with the loaded barbell over your midfoot. t: Set a sturdy box or platform in front of you at a height that puts your lead thigh roughly parallel to the floor when your foot is on it (around knee height to start). | Position a barbell on the back of your shoulders as in a back squat, gripping it just outside shoulder-width, and step close to the box. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and place your lead foot flat and fully on top of the box. | Drive through the heel and mid-foot of your lead leg to push your body straight up, keeping your torso tall and avoiding a forward lean. | Stand up tall on the box, bringing your trailing foot up so you finish balanced over the lead leg. | Lower under control by stepping the trailing foot back down first, keeping tension in the lead leg as you descend. | Place the trailing foot flat on the floor, then return the lead foot to the ground to reset. | Complete your reps on one leg or alternate as programmed, then re-rack the barbell safely in the rack.

nR: Взятие на грудь в сед со штангой
t: Set your feet about hip-width apart with the barbell over the middle of your feet, close to your shins. t: Set a loaded barbell on the floor and stand over it so it runs between your legs, with your feet in a staggered split stance — one foot ahead of the bar, one behind it, roughly hip- to shoulder-width apart. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower your hips, keeping your spine neutral and your chest up. | Take a mixed grip: place one hand on the bar in front of your lead leg and the other hand behind, palms facing in opposite directions, so the bar stays balanced under your hips. | Brace your core, set your weight evenly through both feet, and pull the slack out of the bar before it leaves the floor. | Drive through the floor with your legs and extend your hips to stand the bar up between your legs, keeping it close to your body and your torso square. | Stand tall at the top with your hips and knees fully extended, glutes squeezed, without leaning back or rotating your torso. | Lower the bar under control along the same path, returning your hips back and down until the plates touch the floor. | Reset your stance and grip each rep, and switch which leg leads between sets to train both sides evenly.

t: Set the safety arms in the rack to just below your bottom squat depth, and position the bar at upper-chest height. | Duck under the bar and rack it low across your rear delts and mid-traps, below the spine of the shoulder blades, then grip it just outside shoulder-width and pull your elbows down to lock it in place. | Brace your core, stand up to unrack the bar, and take one or two short steps back to clear the rack. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with your toes turned out about 20–30°. | Take a deep breath, brace hard, and sit back and down by breaking at the hips, leaning your torso forward more than you would on a high-bar squat. | Descend until your hip crease drops to or just below the top of your knees, keeping your knees tracking over your toes and your back flat. | Drive your hips forward and push through your whole foot to stand back up, keeping the bar over your mid-foot. | Complete your reps, step forward to the rack, and lower the bar onto the hooks under control.

t: Start with the bar in the front rack across your shoulders, hands just outside shoulder-width, elbows up and pointed forward, and feet roughly hip-width. | Brace your core hard, set your weight on mid-foot, and keep your torso tall and vertical. | Dip straight down a few inches by bending the knees, keeping your chest up and the bar pinned to your shoulders. | Reverse the dip explosively, driving through your legs to launch the bar straight up off your shoulders. | As the bar leaves your shoulders, punch your arms up and split your feet — front foot forward flat, rear foot back on the ball of the foot — dropping under the bar to receive it overhead. | Catch the bar locked out over the back of your head with both knees bent, the front shin near vertical, and your torso upright between your feet. | Stabilize the overhead lockout, then recover by stepping the front foot back partway, then the rear foot forward, finishing with feet together and the bar still overhead. | Lower the bar under control to the rack or platform to finish the rep.

t: Set a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps and shoulders as you would for a back squat, and grip it firmly with both hands. | Step one foot forward into a staggered split stance, with your front knee bent and your back knee lowered toward the floor. | Brace your core, keep your chest up and your torso tall, and look straight ahead. | Dip slightly by bending both knees, then drive explosively through both feet to jump straight up off the floor. | While airborne, switch your legs so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | Land softly on the balls of both feet with knees bent to absorb the impact, settling into the opposite split stance. | Reset your balance for a moment, then repeat the jump, alternating legs for the prescribed reps or time. | When finished, come to a standing position with feet level and re-rack the barbell safely.

t: Set a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps and shoulders, and grip it slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Step one foot forward into a split stance so your front foot is flat and your back foot is on the ball of the foot, heel raised. | Stand tall with your torso upright, chest up, and core braced; your feet should stay in this fixed position for every rep. | Lower under control by bending both knees, dropping your back knee straight down toward the floor. | Descend until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your back knee hovers just above it. | Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and most of your weight through your front heel. | Drive through your front foot to stand back up to the starting position without locking out hard. | Complete all reps on one leg, then switch the stance and repeat on the other side before re-racking the bar.

t: Load a barbell and stand tall holding it against the front of your thighs with an overhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Take a short step back with one foot so your stance is staggered, keeping the front foot flat and the rear toe lightly touching the floor for balance. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back, keeping your spine neutral from head to hips. | Hinge at the hips, pushing your glutes back and letting the bar travel down close to your front leg with only a slight bend in the front knee. | Lower until you feel a strong stretch in the front-leg hamstring or the bar reaches mid-shin, keeping your back flat throughout. | Drive your front hip forward and squeeze the glute to stand back up to the tall starting position. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the stance and repeat with the other leg leading. | Set the bar down under control on a rack or the floor when finished.

t: Set the bar in a squat rack at about mid-chest height and load it. Position the safety arms just below your bottom squat depth. | Step under the bar and rest it across your upper back on your traps (high-bar) or rear delts (low-bar), gripping it firmly just outside your shoulders. | Brace your core, lift the bar off the hooks by straightening your legs, and take one or two short steps back to clear the rack. | Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart with your toes turned out slightly, and fix your gaze a short distance ahead. | Take a deep breath, brace, and descend by bending at the hips and knees together, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes. | Lower until your hip crease drops to at least parallel with your knees, keeping your weight centered over your midfoot. | Drive through your whole foot to stand back up, extending your hips and knees together until you are fully upright, then exhale. | Complete your reps, then step forward and re-rack the bar onto the hooks under control.

nR: Присед со штангой: колени, конечная точка (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО-ПРАВИЛЬНО)
nH: סקוואט עם מוט - ברכיים - סוף (לא נכון-נכון)
t: Set up under the bar with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out, around 15–30°. | Brace your core and begin descending by sitting your hips back and bending your knees together. | As you lower, actively push your knees outward so each knee tracks in line with the second or third toe of the same foot. | Reach the bottom position with your knees stacked over your feet, not collapsing inward toward each other. | Check the end position: the right position keeps the knees spread out over the toes, while the wrong position lets them cave in past the line of the feet. | Keep your weight balanced across the whole foot, with the heels and the balls of the feet planted. | Drive back up while continuing to press the knees out, then stand tall to finish the rep.
tRu: Set up under the bar with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out, around 15–30°. | Напрягите корпус и начните опускаться, отводя бёдра назад и одновременно сгибая колени. | Опускаясь, активно давите коленями наружу, чтобы каждое колено шло в линию со вторым или третьим пальцем той же стопы. | Reach the bottom position with your knees stacked over your feet, not collapsing inward toward each other. | Проверьте конечное положение: правильное положение удерживает колени разведёнными над носками, тогда как в неправильном положении они заваливаются внутрь за линию стоп. | Keep your weight balanced across the whole foot, with the heels and the balls of the feet planted. | Оттолкнитесь назад, продолжая давать колени наружу, затем встаньте прямо, чтобы завершить повторение.
tHe: Set up under the bar with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out, around 15–30°. | הדק את הליבה והתחל לרדת על ידי הושבת האגן לאחור וכפיפת הברכיים יחד. | בירידה, דחוף את הברכיים החוצה כך שכל ברך תעקוב בקו האצבע השנייה או השלישית של אותה רגל. | Reach the bottom position with your knees stacked over your feet, not collapsing inward toward each other. | בדוק את תנוחת הסיום: התנוחה הנכונה שומרת על הברכים מופרדות מעל האצבעות, בעוד שהתנוחה השגויה מאפשרת להן להתעקם פנימה מעבר לקו הרגליים. | Keep your weight balanced across the whole foot, with the heels and the balls of the feet planted. | Drive back up while continuing to press the knees out, then stand tall to finish the rep.

nR: Присед со штангой: колени, средняя точка (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО-ПРАВИЛЬНО)
nH: סקוואט עם מוט - ברכיים - אמצע (לא נכון-נכון)
t: Set the barbell in a rack at upper-chest height and step under it so the bar rests across your upper back, not your neck. | Grip the bar firmly, unrack it, and step back into a stance roughly shoulder-width or slightly wider, toes turned out a few degrees. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and begin descending by sitting your hips back and bending your knees together. | As you reach the middle of the squat, watch your knees: the wrong position lets them collapse inward toward each other (valgus). | Correct it by actively pushing your knees out so they track in line with your toes throughout the descent. | Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor while keeping the knees aligned over the feet. | Drive through your mid-foot and heels to stand back up, continuing to keep the knees pressed out, not caving in. | Finish the set, then step forward and re-rack the bar safely with control.

t: Set the barbell in a front-rack position across the front of your shoulders, gripping it just outside shoulder-width with your elbows pointing forward and your upper arms roughly parallel to the floor. | Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, and brace your core to lock in a tall, neutral spine. | Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping your chest up and your elbows high until your thighs reach at least parallel to the floor. | Drive hard through your heels to stand up explosively, using the upward momentum to start the bar moving off your shoulders. | As your hips and knees finish extending, press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully locked out and the bar sits over the middle of your feet. | Lower the bar under control back to the front-rack position on your shoulders, resetting your elbows forward. | Re-bend into the next squat to repeat, or finish your reps and lower the bar to a rack or the floor with control.

nR: Присед с вертикальной тягой со штангой

t: Loop the chains over the sleeves so they hang evenly on both sides and a few links rest on the floor when you stand tall, then load any plates and set the bar in the rack at upper-chest height. | Step under the bar and rest it across your upper traps or rear delts, gripping it slightly wider than shoulder-width and pulling your elbows down to lock your upper back tight. | Brace your core, unrack the bar, and take one or two steps back into a stance about shoulder-width with your toes turned slightly out. | Take a deep breath, brace, and sit down and back by bending your hips and knees together, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes. | Descend under control until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, letting more chain settle on the ground as the load lightens at the bottom. | Drive through your whole foot and stand back up, exhaling near the top as the chain links lift off the floor and the bar loads heaviest at lockout. | Stand tall and reset your brace between reps, keeping the bar path vertical over your midfoot. | Complete your reps, step forward, and re-rack the bar safely with control.

nE: Barbell Wide Stance Stiff Leg Deadlift

t: Set a loaded barbell on the floor and stand behind it with your feet noticeably wider than shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out. | Hinge at your hips and grip the bar just inside your knees with both hands, keeping your arms straight. | Brace your core, pull your shoulder blades back, and set a flat, neutral spine with your chest up. | Keep your knees only slightly bent and locked in that position for the whole set — the movement comes from your hips, not your knees. | Drive your hips forward and stand tall, dragging the bar close to your legs until you are upright with hips fully extended. | Push your hips back and lower the bar under control along your legs, feeling a stretch through your hamstrings as your torso descends. | Lower until you feel the limit of your hamstring flexibility without rounding your back, then reverse to stand back up. | Complete your reps, then set the bar down on the floor with a flat back.

t: Set a bench or sturdy platform about knee height behind you and rest the barbell in a rack at lower-chest level. | Bend your knees, hook your elbows under the bar so it sits in the crook of your arms, and hug your hands together over your chest to lock it in place. | Lift the bar out of the rack, brace your core, and step forward into a staggered stance, placing the top of one foot on the bench behind you. | Position your front foot far enough ahead that your shin can stay near vertical when you descend; set your feet about hip-width apart for balance. | Lower under control by bending your front knee and hip, dropping straight down until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor. | Keep your torso tall and the bar tight to your chest as your rear knee tracks down toward the floor without slamming into it. | Drive through your front foot to stand back up to the start, keeping most of your weight on the front leg. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the rear foot and repeat for the other leg before re-racking the bar.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly soft. | Grip the bar with an underhand (palms-up) grip, hands set close together near the center of the bar. | Let the bar hang at arm's length against your thighs, with your elbows tucked close to your sides. | Brace your core and keep your upper arms still as you curl the bar up toward your shoulders. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top, keeping your wrists straight and the bar under control. | Lower the bar slowly back to the starting position, fully straightening your arms. | Complete your reps, then set the bar down with control.

tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים בערך ברוחב הכתפיים וברכיים מעט רכות. | Grip the bar with an underhand (palms-up) grip, hands set close together near the center of the bar. | תן למוט להיתלות לאורך הידיים כנגד הירכיים, עם מרפקים צמודים לצדי הגוף. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על הזרועות העליונות יציבות בזמן שאתה מכופף את המוט כלפי הכתפיים. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top, keeping your wrists straight and the bar under control. | Lower the bar slowly back to the starting position, fully straightening your arms. | סיים את החזרות, ואז הנח את המוט בשליטה.

t: Start on all fours in a quadruped position, with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, about hip-width apart. | Brace your core and keep your back flat and neutral, with your head in line with your spine and your gaze toward the floor. | For the basic kick, keep one knee bent at about 90 degrees and drive that leg straight back and up, pressing the sole of your foot toward the ceiling. | Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower the knee back under your hip with control without letting it touch down. | For the cross kick, drive the same bent leg back and across the midline at a diagonal, kicking it out and away from your body at an angle. | Squeeze the glute again at the top of the cross kick, then return the knee under your hip under control. | Alternate the pattern in a basic-then-cross rhythm, keeping your hips square to the floor and your core tight throughout. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat for an even number of reps on each side.

t: Stand tall with your feet together or hip-width apart, knees soft, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Brace your core lightly and lift your chest, keeping your spine long. | Begin to hinge forward at the hips, letting your head and arms hang down toward the floor. | Continue folding slowly, reaching your fingertips toward your toes until you feel a stretch through your hamstrings and lower back. | Keep your knees only slightly bent and avoid forcing the range — let gravity ease you deeper over a few breaths. | Hold the stretch for 15–30 seconds, breathing steadily and relaxing into the position. | To finish, bend your knees slightly and roll back up one vertebra at a time until you are standing tall again.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding a stability ball at chest height with both hands. | Brace your core and keep your chest up and eyes forward as if facing the hoop. | Bend at the hips and knees to drop into a quarter-to-half squat, keeping the ball in close to your chest and your weight on the middle of your feet. | Drive explosively through your feet and extend your hips, knees, and ankles to jump straight up. | As you rise, push the stability ball up and overhead with both arms, finishing the motion like a shooting follow-through. | Reach full extension at the top of the jump with the ball overhead. | Land softly on the balls of your feet, then sink into your heels and immediately re-bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact. | Bring the ball back to chest height, reset your stance, and repeat for the desired reps or time.

nE: Battling Ropes Alternate Arms Jump Squat
nR: Присед в прыжке с канатами попеременно
t: Anchor the rope securely and stand facing it, feet a little wider than shoulder-width, with an end of the rope gripped firmly in each hand. | Drop into a quarter to half squat, hinging at the hips with your chest up, back flat, and arms hanging in front of you. | Begin driving the ropes in alternating waves, raising and lowering one arm after the other in a quick, continuous rhythm. | On a chosen beat, explode upward into a jump squat, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the ropes moving. | Land softly back into the squat with bent knees to absorb the impact, never letting the rope waves stop. | Keep alternating the arm waves and cycling jump squats at a steady, hard pace for the full work interval. | When the interval ends, slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and rest before the next round.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите канат и встаньте лицом к нему, стопы чуть шире плеч, крепко удерживая по концу каната в каждой руке. | Примите положение приседа на четверть или половину, отводите бёдра назад, держите грудь вверх, спину прямой и руки перед собой. | Начните гнать волны по канатам попеременно, поднимая и опуская руки одну за другой в быстром непрерывном ритме. | On a chosen beat, explode upward into a jump squat, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while keeping the ropes moving. | Land softly back into the squat with bent knees to absorb the impact, never letting the rope waves stop. | Keep alternating the arm waves and cycling jump squats at a steady, hard pace for the full work interval. | When the interval ends, slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and rest before the next round.
