nE: Battling Ropes Alternate Arms Side Lunge
t: Anchor the battle rope around a sturdy post and pick up one end in each hand, gripping the ends like hammers with a neutral grip. | Step back until the rope has a little slack and stand in an athletic stance with your feet wider than shoulder-width, knees soft, and chest up. | Brace your core and begin making rapid alternating waves — drive one arm down as the other comes up so the ropes move out of sync. | Keep the waves going continuously while you sit back and lunge to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips back while the other leg stays long. | Push off the bent leg to return to center, then lunge to the opposite side, never letting the rope waves stop. | Stay tall through your torso and keep the waves traveling all the way to the anchor as you move side to side. | Continue alternating lunges and waves for the prescribed time or reps, keeping a steady rhythm. | Finish by slowing the waves to a stop, returning to a centered stance, and setting the rope ends down under control.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат вокруг прочной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку, удерживая концы как молотки нейтральным хватом. | Step back until the rope has a little slack and stand in an athletic stance with your feet wider than shoulder-width, knees soft, and chest up. | Напрягите корпус и начните делать быстрые попеременные волны — опускайте одну руку вниз, пока другая идёт вверх, чтобы канаты двигались в противофазе. | Keep the waves going continuously while you sit back and lunge to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips back while the other leg stays long. | Push off the bent leg to return to center, then lunge to the opposite side, never letting the rope waves stop. | Stay tall through your torso and keep the waves traveling all the way to the anchor as you move side to side. | Продолжайте попеременно выполнять выпады и волны в течение заданного времени или повторений, сохраняя устойчивый ритм. | Finish by slowing the waves to a stop, returning to a centered stance, and setting the rope ends down under control.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב סביב עמוד יציב והרם קצה אחד בכל יד, תוך אחיזה כמו פטיש באחיזה ניטרלית. | Step back until the rope has a little slack and stand in an athletic stance with your feet wider than shoulder-width, knees soft, and chest up. | הדק את הליבה והתחל ליצור גלים מהירים לסירוגין — הורד יד אחת כשהשנייה עולה כך שהחבלים נעים בניגוד. | Keep the waves going continuously while you sit back and lunge to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips back while the other leg stays long. | Push off the bent leg to return to center, then lunge to the opposite side, never letting the rope waves stop. | Stay tall through your torso and keep the waves traveling all the way to the anchor as you move side to side. | Continue alternating lunges and waves for the prescribed time or reps, keeping a steady rhythm. | Finish by slowing the waves to a stop, returning to a centered stance, and setting the rope ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battle rope around a sturdy post or rack, then grab one end in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other. | Walk back until the rope has a slight slack and stand facing the anchor with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width. | Brace your core, push your hips back and bend your knees to drop into a squat, keeping your chest up and back flat. | Hold the squat depth (or squat rhythmically with the waves) while keeping your weight balanced through your mid-foot. | Begin alternating waves: drive one arm up forcefully, then snap it down as you raise the other arm, so the rope ends move out of sync. | Keep the waves fast and continuous, generating the movement from your shoulders, arms and back rather than your wrists alone. | Maintain the squat position and steady breathing as you cycle the arms for the prescribed time or rep count. | Slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, then stand up from the squat under control to finish.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат вокруг прочной стойки или рамы, затем возьмите по концу в каждую руку нейтральным хватом, ладони друг к другу. | Walk back until the rope has a slight slack and stand facing the anchor with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width. | Напрягите корпус, отведите бёдра назад и согните колени, опускаясь в присед, удерживая грудь вверх, а спину прямой. | Hold the squat depth (or squat rhythmically with the waves) while keeping your weight balanced through your mid-foot. | Начните попеременные волны: мощно поднимите одну руку вверх, затем резко опустите её, поднимая другую руку, чтобы концы каната двигались не в такт. | Keep the waves fast and continuous, generating the movement from your shoulders, arms and back rather than your wrists alone. | Maintain the squat position and steady breathing as you cycle the arms for the prescribed time or rep count. | Slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, then stand up from the squat under control to finish.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב סביב עמוד יציב או מתקן, ואז אחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד באחיזה ניטרלית, כפות הידיים פונות זו לזו. | Walk back until the rope has a slight slack and stand facing the anchor with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width. | הדק את הליבה, דחוף את האגן לאחור וכופף את הברכיים לירידה לסקוואט, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם וגב שטוח. | Hold the squat depth (or squat rhythmically with the waves) while keeping your weight balanced through your mid-foot. | התחל בגלים מתחלפים: דחוף זרוע אחת בחוזקה למעלה, ואז הצלף אותה למטה בזמן שאתה מרים את הזרוע השנייה, כך שקצות החבל נעים בניגוד. | Keep the waves fast and continuous, generating the movement from your shoulders, arms and back rather than your wrists alone. | Maintain the squat position and steady breathing as you cycle the arms for the prescribed time or rep count. | Slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, then stand up from the squat under control to finish.

nE: Battling Ropes Alternating Waves with Kneeling Get-Up
nR: Попеременные волны с канатами со вставанием с колен
nH: גלים לסירוגין בחבלי קרב עם קימה מכריעה
t: Anchor the battling rope securely, take one end in each hand, and step back until there is a light tension in the rope. | Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, knees softly bent, core braced, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Begin alternating waves by driving one arm down as the other comes up, snapping from the shoulders to send a steady ripple down each side of the rope. | Keep the waves moving continuously and, without stopping the rhythm, lower one knee to the floor, then the other, until you are kneeling on both knees. | Reverse the get-up by stepping one foot up, then the other, returning to a tall standing stance while the rope never stops waving. | Maintain the alternating waves throughout the entire transition, breathing in a steady rhythm rather than holding your breath. | Continue cycling down to kneeling and back to standing for the full work interval. | At the end of the interval, slow the waves to a stop, set the rope ends down, and rest before the next round.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат, возьмите по концу в каждую руку и отойдите назад до лёгкого натяжения каната. | Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, knees softly bent, core braced, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Начните попеременные волны, опуская одну руку вниз, пока другая поднимается, резко работая от плеч, чтобы послать устойчивую волну по каждой стороне каната. | Keep the waves moving continuously and, without stopping the rhythm, lower one knee to the floor, then the other, until you are kneeling on both knees. | Reverse the get-up by stepping one foot up, then the other, returning to a tall standing stance while the rope never stops waving. | Maintain the alternating waves throughout the entire transition, breathing in a steady rhythm rather than holding your breath. | Продолжайте циклически опускаться на колени и вставать обратно в течение всего рабочего интервала. | В конце интервала постепенно остановите волны, положите концы каната и отдохните перед следующим раундом.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב, אחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד, וצעד לאחור עד למתח קל בחבל. | Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, knees softly bent, core braced, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | התחל בגלים מתחלפים על ידי הורדת זרוע אחת בזמן שהשנייה עולה, הצלף מהכתפיים כדי לשלוח גל יציב לאורך כל צד של החבל. | Keep the waves moving continuously and, without stopping the rhythm, lower one knee to the floor, then the other, until you are kneeling on both knees. | Reverse the get-up by stepping one foot up, then the other, returning to a tall standing stance while the rope never stops waving. | Maintain the alternating waves throughout the entire transition, breathing in a steady rhythm rather than holding your breath. | Continue cycling down to kneeling and back to standing for the full work interval. | בסוף האינטרוול האט את הגלים עד לעצירה, הנח את קצות החבל, ונוח לפני הסיבוב הבא.

t: Anchor the battling rope at its midpoint to a fixed post, and grip one end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then settle into an athletic stance: feet shoulder-width, knees soft, hips back, core braced. | Hold both arms out in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent and palms facing each other, with a little tension already in the ropes. | Sweep both arms wide and outward to your sides in a controlled fly arc, driving waves down the ropes as your hands separate. | Reverse the motion smoothly, bringing both arms back toward the centerline in front of your chest to complete one fly. | Keep the ropes moving continuously, repeating the outward-and-together sweep at a steady, hard pace. | Maintain your braced stance throughout, then slow the waves and set the rope ends down to finish.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат за середину к фиксированной стойке и возьмите по концу в каждую руку крепким нейтральным хватом. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then settle into an athletic stance: feet shoulder-width, knees soft, hips back, core braced. | Hold both arms out in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent and palms facing each other, with a little tension already in the ropes. | Sweep both arms wide and outward to your sides in a controlled fly arc, driving waves down the ropes as your hands separate. | Reverse the motion smoothly, bringing both arms back toward the centerline in front of your chest to complete one fly. | Keep the ropes moving continuously, repeating the outward-and-together sweep at a steady, hard pace. | Maintain your braced stance throughout, then slow the waves and set the rope ends down to finish.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב באמצע שלו לעמוד קבוע, ואחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד באחיזה ניטרלית וחזקה. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then settle into an athletic stance: feet shoulder-width, knees soft, hips back, core braced. | Hold both arms out in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent and palms facing each other, with a little tension already in the ropes. | Sweep both arms wide and outward to your sides in a controlled fly arc, driving waves down the ropes as your hands separate. | Reverse the motion smoothly, bringing both arms back toward the centerline in front of your chest to complete one fly. | Keep the ropes moving continuously, repeating the outward-and-together sweep at a steady, hard pace. | Maintain your braced stance throughout, then slow the waves and set the rope ends down to finish.

t: Anchor the battle rope securely at its midpoint and back away until the rope is nearly taut, leaving a slight bend in the line. | Drop into a half-kneeling position with one knee on the floor and the opposite foot flat in front, knee bent to about 90°. | Take one rope end in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, and let your arms hang just in front of your thighs. | Brace your core and keep your torso tall, stacking your shoulders over your hips so your trunk stays stable. | Drive the ropes by rapidly raising and lowering your arms in an alternating rhythm, snapping waves down the full length of the rope. | Keep the waves consistent and powerful, breathing steadily and resisting any urge to rock or twist your torso for momentum. | Work for your prescribed time or round, then pause briefly and switch the kneeling leg so the other knee is down. | Repeat the waves from the opposite stance, then set the ropes down and rest before your next round.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат за середину и отойдите назад, пока канат не станет почти натянутым, оставив лёгкий прогиб. | Примите положение на коленях, с одним коленом на полу и противоположной ногой, стоящей перед собой, колено согнуто под углом примерно 90°. | Take one rope end in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, and let your arms hang just in front of your thighs. | Напрягите корпус и держите корпус прямо, расположив плечи над бёдрами, чтобы туловище оставалось стабильным. | Оттолкните канаты, быстро поднимая и опуская руки в чередующемся ритме, создавая волны по всей длине канатов. | Keep the waves consistent and powerful, breathing steadily and resisting any urge to rock or twist your torso for momentum. | Work for your prescribed time or round, then pause briefly and switch the kneeling leg so the other knee is down. | Repeat the waves from the opposite stance, then set the ropes down and rest before your next round.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב באמצע שלו והתרחק עד שהחבל כמעט מתוח, תוך השארת כיפוף קל. | Drop into a half-kneeling position with one knee on the floor and the opposite foot flat in front, knee bent to about 90°. | Take one rope end in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other, and let your arms hang just in front of your thighs. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גו זקוף, כשהכתפיים מעל האגן כדי שהגוף יישאר יציב. | Drive the ropes by rapidly raising and lowering your arms in an alternating rhythm, snapping waves down the full length of the rope. | Keep the waves consistent and powerful, breathing steadily and resisting any urge to rock or twist your torso for momentum. | Work for your prescribed time or round, then pause briefly and switch the kneeling leg so the other knee is down. | Repeat the waves from the opposite stance, then set the ropes down and rest before your next round.

t: Anchor the battling rope around a fixed post and grab one end in each hand, holding them like hammers with a firm grip. | Walk back until there is light tension in the rope, then stand in an athletic stance with feet about shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and let your shoulders sit down and back. | Drive both arms up and overhead at the same time, raising the rope as high as you can while keeping your torso stable. | Slam both rope ends down forcefully toward the floor, throwing a large wave down each side of the rope. | Absorb the movement through your legs and core as the rope reaches the bottom, keeping your back flat. | Immediately raise both arms back up to repeat, working at a hard, steady pace for the prescribed time. | Slow the waves down to finish the interval, then set the rope ends down under control.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку, держа их как молотки крепким хватом. | Walk back until there is light tension in the rope, then stand in an athletic stance with feet about shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and let your shoulders sit down and back. | Одновременно поднимите обе руки вверх и над головой, поднимая канат как можно выше, сохраняя корпус стабильным. | Slam both rope ends down forcefully toward the floor, throwing a large wave down each side of the rope. | Поглощайте движение ногами и корпусом, когда канат достигает нижней точки, удерживая спину прямой. | Immediately raise both arms back up to repeat, working at a hard, steady pace for the prescribed time. | Slow the waves down to finish the interval, then set the rope ends down under control.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב סביב עמוד קבוע ואחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד, כמו פטישים באחיזה חזקה. | Walk back until there is light tension in the rope, then stand in an athletic stance with feet about shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and let your shoulders sit down and back. | Drive both arms up and overhead at the same time, raising the rope as high as you can while keeping your torso stable. | Slam both rope ends down forcefully toward the floor, throwing a large wave down each side of the rope. | ספוג את התנועה דרך הרגליים והליבה כשהחבל מגיע למטה, תוך שמירה על גב שטוח. | Immediately raise both arms back up to repeat, working at a hard, steady pace for the prescribed time. | Slow the waves down to finish the interval, then set the rope ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battle rope securely around a fixed post or weight and step back until the rope is almost taut, with no slack dragging on the floor. | Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, bend your knees, hinge your hips back slightly, and keep your back flat. | Grab one rope end in each hand near the tip with a firm grip, holding your arms in front of your thighs. | Brace your core and keep your chest up so force can transfer from your legs and back into the rope. | Drive both arms in fast, inward circles toward your body's midline, leading from the shoulders and chest so each hand carves a continuous loop. | Keep the circles tight and the waves even, staying low in your stance and breathing in a steady rhythm. | Maintain the inward circling for the full work interval, keeping constant tension on the rope. | To finish, slow the circles, let the waves settle, and set the rope ends down under control.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной стойки или отягощения и отойдите назад, пока канат не станет почти натянутым, без слабины на полу. | Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, bend your knees, hinge your hips back slightly, and keep your back flat. | Grab one rope end in each hand near the tip with a firm grip, holding your arms in front of your thighs. | Напрягите корпус и держите грудь расправленной, чтобы усилие передавалось от ног и спины в канат. | Одновременно двигайте обе руки быстрыми, внутренними кругами к средней линии тела, ведя плечами и грудью, чтобы каждая рука описывала непрерывную петлю. | Keep the circles tight and the waves even, staying low in your stance and breathing in a steady rhythm. | Maintain the inward circling for the full work interval, keeping constant tension on the rope. | To finish, slow the circles, let the waves settle, and set the rope ends down under control.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב סביב עמוד קבוע או משקולת וצעד לאחור עד שהחבל כמעט מתוח, בלי רפיון שנגרר על הרצפה. | Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, bend your knees, hinge your hips back slightly, and keep your back flat. | Grab one rope end in each hand near the tip with a firm grip, holding your arms in front of your thighs. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה מורם כדי שהכוח יעבור מהרגליים והגב לחבל. | Drive both arms in fast, inward circles toward your body's midline, leading from the shoulders and chest so each hand carves a continuous loop. | Keep the circles tight and the waves even, staying low in your stance and breathing in a steady rhythm. | Maintain the inward circling for the full work interval, keeping constant tension on the rope. | To finish, slow the circles, let the waves settle, and set the rope ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battling rope around a sturdy fixed point and pick up one end in each hand with a neutral grip. | Step back until the rope has just a slight slack, then stand tall with your feet together and your arms hanging down in front of your hips. | Brace your core and bend slightly at the knees and hips to set an athletic, springy stance. | Begin driving each arm up and down to send steady, continuous waves down the rope. | As the waves start, jump your feet out to about shoulder-width and land softly on the balls of your feet. | Jump your feet back together while keeping the rope waves unbroken and even. | Keep the jump-out and jump-in rhythm matched to the waves so your legs and arms move as one unit, breathing steadily. | Continue for the prescribed time or interval, then slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, and set both ends down under control.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат вокруг прочной фиксированной точки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку нейтральным хватом. | Step back until the rope has just a slight slack, then stand tall with your feet together and your arms hanging down in front of your hips. | Напрягите корпус и слегка согните колени и бёдра, заняв атлетичную пружинистую стойку. | Начните двигать каждую руку вверх и вниз, посылая по канату устойчивые непрерывные волны. | С началом волн расставьте ноги прыжком примерно на ширину плеч и мягко приземлитесь на подушечки стоп. | Jump your feet back together while keeping the rope waves unbroken and even. | Keep the jump-out and jump-in rhythm matched to the waves so your legs and arms move as one unit, breathing steadily. | Продолжайте в течение заданного времени или количества положений, дыша ровно.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב סביב נקודה קבועה ויציבה והרם קצה אחד בכל יד באחיזה ניטרלית. | Step back until the rope has just a slight slack, then stand tall with your feet together and your arms hanging down in front of your hips. | הדק את הליבה וכופף מעט את הברכיים והאגן כדי ליצור עמידה אתלטית וקפיצית. | התחל להניע כל זרוע מעלה ומטה כדי לשלוח גלים יציבים ורציפים לאורך החבל. | כשהגלים מתחילים, קפוץ עם הרגליים לרוחב הכתפיים בערך ונחת ברכות על כריות כפות הרגליים. | Jump your feet back together while keeping the rope waves unbroken and even. | Keep the jump-out and jump-in rhythm matched to the waves so your legs and arms move as one unit, breathing steadily. | Continue for the prescribed time or interval, then slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, and set both ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battling rope securely around a fixed post and grab one end in each hand, gripping near the capped tips with a neutral (palms-facing) grip. | Step back until there is a slight tension in the rope, then face the anchor point. | Set a low athletic stance: feet a little wider than shoulder-width, knees bent, hips pushed back, and chest up. | Brace your core and keep your back flat, with your weight balanced over the middle of your feet. | Drive one arm up quickly and snap it back down to send a wave through that rope, keeping the movement low and compact. | As the first arm comes down, drive the other arm up so the ropes alternate in a fast, continuous rhythm. | Stay low throughout, keeping your arms close to your sides and the waves short and powerful rather than wide and loose. | Continue alternating for the full work interval, then slow the ropes under control and stand up.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку, удерживая у наконечников нейтральным хватом ладонями друг к другу. | Step back until there is a slight tension in the rope, then face the anchor point. | Set a low athletic stance: feet a little wider than shoulder-width, knees bent, hips pushed back, and chest up. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте спину прямой, распределяя вес на середину стоп. | Быстро поднимите одну руку вверх и резко опустите ее вниз, чтобы создать волну по этому канату, сохраняя движение низким и компактным. | Когда первая рука идёт вниз, поднимайте другую руку вверх, чтобы канаты чередовались в быстром непрерывном ритме. | Stay low throughout, keeping your arms close to your sides and the waves short and powerful rather than wide and loose. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать в течение всего интервала работы, затем замедлите движение канатов с контролем и встаньте.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב סביב עמוד קבוע ואחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד, ליד הקצוות הסגורים באחיזה ניטרלית (כפות פונות זו לזו). | Step back until there is a slight tension in the rope, then face the anchor point. | Set a low athletic stance: feet a little wider than shoulder-width, knees bent, hips pushed back, and chest up. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גב שטוח, כשהמשקל מאוזן על אמצע כפות הרגליים. | Drive one arm up quickly and snap it back down to send a wave through that rope, keeping the movement low and compact. | כשהזרוע הראשונה יורדת, דחוף את הזרוע השנייה למעלה כך שהחבלים יתחלפו בקצב מהיר ורציף. | Stay low throughout, keeping your arms close to your sides and the waves short and powerful rather than wide and loose. | Continue alternating for the full work interval, then slow the ropes under control and stand up.

t: Anchor the battling rope around a fixed point and grab one end in each hand, gripping firmly with your thumbs wrapped around. | Step back until there is light tension in the ropes, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Drop into an athletic half-squat with knees soft, hips back, chest up, and your core braced. | Sweep both arms outward in matching circles, moving the ropes away from your midline in a wide, continuous loop. | Keep the circles even and symmetrical on both sides, sending steady waves down the ropes toward the anchor. | Stay low through the hips and tall through the torso, breathing in a controlled rhythm as the ropes keep moving. | Maintain the pace for your work interval, then slow the circles under control and set the ropes down.
tRu: Закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной точки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку, крепко обхватив их большими пальцами. | Step back until there is light tension in the ropes, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Примите положение спортивного полуприседа с мягкими коленями, отведёнными бёдрами, поднятой грудью и напряжённым корпусом. | Sweep both arms outward in matching circles, moving the ropes away from your midline in a wide, continuous loop. | Keep the circles even and symmetrical on both sides, sending steady waves down the ropes toward the anchor. | Stay low through the hips and tall through the torso, breathing in a controlled rhythm as the ropes keep moving. | Maintain the pace for your work interval, then slow the circles under control and set the ropes down.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב סביב נקודה קבועה ואחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד, תוך אחיזה חזקה עם אגודלים כרוכים. | Step back until there is light tension in the ropes, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Drop into an athletic half-squat with knees soft, hips back, chest up, and your core braced. | Sweep both arms outward in matching circles, moving the ropes away from your midline in a wide, continuous loop. | Keep the circles even and symmetrical on both sides, sending steady waves down the ropes toward the anchor. | Stay low through the hips and tall through the torso, breathing in a controlled rhythm as the ropes keep moving. | Maintain the pace for your work interval, then slow the circles under control and set the ropes down.

t: Anchor the rope securely around a sturdy post and grab one end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip. | Step back until the rope is taut with a slight slack, set your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, and bend your knees into an athletic quarter-squat. | Brace your core and hinge slightly at the hips, keeping your chest up and your back flat. | Drive through your legs and extend your hips as you swing both rope ends explosively up overhead to full reach, rising onto the balls of your feet. | Slam both ends straight down to the floor in front of you with maximum force, snapping your hips and bracing your waist on impact. | Let your knees re-bend to absorb the slam, keeping your weight centered over your feet. | Reload to the overhead position and repeat at a fast, continuous pace for the prescribed time or reps. | On your final slam, control the ropes to a stop, set them down, and step back to recover your breath and grip.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите канат вокруг прочной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку крепким нейтральным хватом. | Step back until the rope is taut with a slight slack, set your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, and bend your knees into an athletic quarter-squat. | Напрягите корпус и слегка наклонитесь в бёдрах, удерживая грудь расправленной, а спину — прямой. | Отталкивайтесь ногами и тазом, чтобы начать движение, затем мощно поднимите оба конца каната над головой до полного выпрямления, вставая на носки. | Slam both ends straight down to the floor in front of you with maximum force, snapping your hips and bracing your waist on impact. | Let your knees re-bend to absorb the slam, keeping your weight centered over your feet. | Reload to the overhead position and repeat at a fast, continuous pace for the prescribed time or reps. | On your final slam, control the ropes to a stop, set them down, and step back to recover your breath and grip.

t: Anchor the battle rope securely, then sit on the floor facing the anchor with your knees bent and heels planted (or hovering for more difficulty). | Grip the ends of the rope together with both hands and lean your torso back slightly to find a stable, braced position. | Brace your core and lift your chest, keeping your spine long rather than rounded. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Keep the rope moving from your core rotation, not just your arms, so the obliques drive each twist. | Continue alternating sides at a steady, controlled pace for the full work interval. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат, затем сядьте на пол лицом к креплению, согнув колени и уперев пятки или удерживая их на весу для сложности. | Grip the ends of the rope together with both hands and lean your torso back slightly to find a stable, braced position. | Напрягите корпус и приподнимите грудь, сохраняя позвоночник вытянутым, а не округлённым. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Keep the rope moving from your core rotation, not just your arms, so the obliques drive each twist. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в устойчивом, контролируемом темпе на протяжении всего рабочего интервала. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב, ואז שב על הרצפה מול העוגן עם ברכיים כפופות ועקבים נעוצים (או מרחפים לדרגת קושי גבוהה יותר). | Grip the ends of the rope together with both hands and lean your torso back slightly to find a stable, braced position. | הדק את הליבה והרם את החזה, תוך שמירה על עמוד שדרה ארוך ולא מעוגל. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Keep the rope moving from your core rotation, not just your arms, so the obliques drive each twist. | Continue alternating sides at a steady, controlled pace for the full work interval. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.

t: Anchor the battling rope securely around a fixed post or rack and take up most of the slack. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a relaxed, neutral grip and let your elbows bend slightly. | Begin driving both arms up and down in fast, alternating waves, snapping the rope from your arms. | Keep the waves continuous and even, moving the rope through its full range without letting the slack die out. | Breathe in a steady rhythm and hold the pace for your work interval, typically 20–40 seconds. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной стойки или рамы и уберите большую часть слабины. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a relaxed, neutral grip and let your elbows bend slightly. | Начните быстро двигать обе руки вверх и вниз попеременными волнами, резко работая канатом от рук. | Keep the waves continuous and even, moving the rope through its full range without letting the slack die out. | Дышите в устойчивом ритме и поддерживайте этот темп для вашего рабочего интервала, обычно 20–40 секунд. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב סביב עמוד קבוע או מתקן ומתח את רוב הרפיון. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a relaxed, neutral grip and let your elbows bend slightly. | התחל להניע את שתי הזרועות מעלה ומטה בגלים מהירים ומתחלפים, תוך הצלפת החבל מהזרועות. | Keep the waves continuous and even, moving the rope through its full range without letting the slack die out. | נשור בקצב יציב ושמור על הקצב לרבע העבודה שלך, בדרך כלל 20-40 שניות. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.

t: Anchor the middle of the rope around a sturdy post or fixed point and walk back until the slack is taken up and you feel slight tension. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip and your palms facing your body. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Keep a tall chest and flat back, letting your shoulders settle down and back before you start. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | Bring the rope ends back toward your hips under control, then immediately repeat to keep continuous motion on the line. | Drive the ropes in a fast, even rhythm for the full work interval, breathing steadily throughout. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.
tRu: Закрепите середину каната вокруг прочной стойки или фиксированной точки и отойдите назад, пока слабина не уйдёт и не почувствуется лёгкое натяжение. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip and your palms facing your body. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Keep a tall chest and flat back, letting your shoulders settle down and back before you start. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | Подтяните концы каната к бедрам под контролем, затем сразу повторите, чтобы сохранить непрерывное движение. | Оттолкните канаты в быстром, равномерном ритме на протяжении всего рабочего интервала, дыша ровно. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.
tHe: עגן את אמצע החבל סביב עמוד יציב או נקודה קבועה וצעד לאחור עד שהרפיון נמתח ואתה מרגיש מתח קל. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip and your palms facing your body. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Keep a tall chest and flat back, letting your shoulders settle down and back before you start. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | הבא את קצות החבל בחזרה לכיוון המותניים בשליטה, ואז חזור מיד כדי לשמור על תנועה רציפה. | Drive the ropes in a fast, even rhythm for the full work interval, breathing steadily throughout. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.

nE: Battling Ropes Side to Side Arms
nR: Руки из стороны в сторону с канатами
t: Anchor the rope around a sturdy post and pick up one end in each hand, palms facing each other. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with a soft bend in your knees. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and keep your chest tall with both arms in front of you. | Sweep both rope ends together to one side, rotating through your waist while keeping your hips and knees stable. | Reverse the motion and swing both ends across to the opposite side, letting the back and chest help control the path. | Keep the waves continuous and rhythmic, rotating only through the trunk rather than swinging the arms loosely. | Maintain a fast, steady tempo for the full work interval, breathing in a controlled rhythm. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set both ends down, and rest before the next round.

t: Anchor the battle ropes and stand facing the anchor with the slack removed. Hold one rope end in each hand using a neutral grip. | Drop into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot back, both knees bent toward 90°, and brace your core. | Begin driving the ropes up and down in fast, alternating waves, keeping your arms moving continuously throughout the set. | Without stopping the waves, push explosively through both legs and jump up off the floor. | Switch your legs in mid-air so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | Absorb the landing softly into a split stance, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes. | Continue jumping and switching legs each rep while the ropes keep moving, breathing in a steady rhythm. | Finish the work interval, slow the ropes to a stop, and step out of the split stance to recover.

Возьмите по концу каната в каждую руку нейтральным хватом. | Примите положение выпада с одной ногой впереди и другой сзади, оба колена согнуты под углом примерно 90°, и напрягите мышцы кора. | Начните двигать канаты вверх и вниз быстрыми попеременными волнами, не останавливая движение рук в течение всего подхода. | Without stopping the waves, push explosively through both legs and jump up off the floor. | Switch your legs in mid-air so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | Мягко поглотите приземление в разножку, удерживая грудь высоко, а колени над носками. | Продолжайте прыгать и менять ноги при каждом повторении, пока канат находится в движении, дыша в устойчивом ритме. | Finish the work interval, slow the ropes to a stop, and step out of the split stance to recover.

t: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, feet hip-width apart with toes tucked. | Lift your knees about an inch off the floor and set your hips low, roughly level with your shoulders, with a flat back and braced core. | Spread your fingers and grip the floor, keeping your weight balanced evenly between your hands and the balls of your feet. | Move your right hand and left foot forward at the same time, taking a short, controlled step. | Follow immediately with your left hand and right foot, keeping the contralateral (opposite arm, opposite leg) rhythm. | Keep your knees hovering just above the ground and your hips low throughout — avoid letting your back round or your hips pike up. | Continue crawling forward for the prescribed distance or time, breathing steadily and keeping each step small and stable. | To finish, lower your knees to the floor, release the brace, and stand up under control.

t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away, rounding your upper back slightly so your shoulder blades stay flat and wide. | Brace your core as if bracing for a punch and tuck your tailbone slightly so your lower back stays flat, not arched. | Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor, keeping your shins roughly parallel to the ground. | Hold the hover with your back flat from head to hips, breathing steadily and keeping your hips level with your shoulders. | Keep your gaze a few inches ahead of your hands so your neck stays in line with your spine. | Hold for the prescribed time, then lower your knees back to the floor under control to finish.

t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Brace your core, press into the floor, and lift your knees about an inch off the ground to find the bear plank position with a flat back. | Keep your hips level and your weight balanced evenly between both hands and your supporting foot. | Extend one leg straight back and up in a controlled kickback, squeezing the hip at the top without arching your lower back. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping the rest of your body still and your hips square to the floor. | Lower the leg back to the bear plank hover under control, returning the knee toward the start without resting it on the floor. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat for equal work on both sides. | Set both knees down gently to finish.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed, and core gently braced, with your partner positioned behind you. | Clasp your hands or interlace your fingers behind your head, resting your palms against the back of your skull with your elbows pointing out to the sides. | Keep your chin level and your neck neutral so the stretch stays in your chest, not your neck. | Have your partner take hold of your elbows and slowly draw them back and out until you feel a comfortable stretch across the front of your chest. | Lift your chest slightly and let your shoulder blades draw together to deepen the opening through the pectorals. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly while your partner maintains light, steady pressure. | Signal your partner to ease off gradually, then bring your elbows forward and lower your arms to relax. | Repeat for 2–3 holds, easing a little deeper only as the muscle relaxes.

t: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and about shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet out in front of you and slide your hips off the bench so your weight is supported on your hands, arms fully extended. | Keep your legs straight or slightly bent with your heels on the floor, chest tall, and shoulders pulled down away from your ears. | Bend your elbows and lower your body straight down, keeping your elbows pointing back and tracking close to your body. | Descend under control until your elbows reach roughly a 90-degree angle and your back stays close to the bench. | Press through your palms to drive your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then walk your feet in and sit back on the bench to finish.

t: Sit just in front of a sturdy bench or low edge and place your hands on it behind you, shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing toward your body. | Walk your feet out and rest your heels on the floor, then press through your hands to lift your hips clear of the bench with your arms extended. | Set your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your chest tall and your torso close to the bench. | Lower your hips straight down by bending your elbows back, keeping them tucked close to your body rather than flaring out to the sides. | Descend until your elbows reach about a 90° angle, keeping your back near the bench the whole way down. | Press back up by straightening your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are nearly fully extended. | Stop just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps, then begin the next rep. | Complete your reps, then lower your hips, sit back, and release your hands under control.

t: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the front edge. | Set a stability ball about a leg's length in front of the bench and rest your heels on top of it with your legs extended. | Slide your hips forward off the bench so your weight is supported by your hands and your heels, keeping your arms straight. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips and the ball steady before your first rep. | Bend your elbows to lower your hips straight down, keeping them pointing back rather than flaring out, until they reach about 90°. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping the ball from rolling, then press through your palms to extend your arms. | Lock out at the top by fully straightening your elbows and squeezing your triceps without shrugging your shoulders. | Complete your reps, then place your feet on the floor and sit back onto the bench to finish.

nE: Bench Dip with legs on bench
nR: Обратные отжимания с ногами на скамье
t: Set up two benches roughly the length of your legs apart, one behind you for your hands and one in front for your feet. | Sit on the edge of the rear bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the edge. | Walk your heels onto the front bench so your legs are straight and your hips are lifted off the bench, supporting your weight on your hands. | Keep your chest up, shoulders pulled down away from your ears, and your core braced. | Bend your elbows to lower your hips straight down until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows pointing back, not flaring out. | Pause briefly when your shoulders reach about elbow height, keeping the weight over your hands. | Press through your palms to extend your elbows and drive your hips back up to the start, stopping just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps. | Complete your reps, then bend your knees and bring your feet down to step out of the position safely.

nR: Обратные скручивания по кругу на скамье
t: Lie on your back along a flat bench with your hips near the end of the bench and your head supported. | Reach overhead and grip the edge of the bench behind your head with both hands to anchor your upper body. | Raise your legs and bend your knees so your thighs are roughly vertical over your hips, feet relaxed. | Brace your abs and draw your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips slightly off the bench. | Begin tracing a slow circle with your knees — guide them to one side, down and around, and back up toward your chest. | Keep the movement driven by your abs and hips, not by swinging your legs, so your lower back stays controlled. | Complete your reps in one direction, then reverse the circle for the same number of reps the other way. | Lower your feet under control to finish, keeping tension on your core until your legs are down.

t: Fill a sturdy water bottle to a weight you can control and grip it firmly in one hand. | Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, keeping a flat back and a soft bend in your knees. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades back so your spine stays neutral throughout the set. | Raise your upper arm so it is tucked against your side and parallel to the floor, with your elbow bent to about 90 degrees and the bottle hanging down. | Keeping your upper arm still, extend your forearm straight back until your arm is fully straight and you feel the triceps contract. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the triceps without letting your elbow drift or your shoulder roll forward. | Lower the bottle under control back to the 90-degree start position. | Complete your reps on one arm, then switch the bottle to the other hand and repeat.

tHe: Fill a sturdy water bottle to a weight you can control and grip it firmly in one hand. | Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, keeping a flat back and a soft bend in your knees. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות לאחור כדי שעמוד השדרה יישאר ניטרלי לאורך כל הסט. | Raise your upper arm so it is tucked against your side and parallel to the floor, with your elbow bent to about 90 degrees and the bottle hanging down. | Keeping your upper arm still, extend your forearm straight back until your arm is fully straight and you feel the triceps contract. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the triceps without letting your elbow drift or your shoulder roll forward. | Lower the bottle under control back to the 90-degree start position. | בצע את החזרות שלך בזרוע אחת, ואז החלף את הבקבוק ליד השנייה וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Kneel upright on a mat with your knees about hip-width apart, the tops of your feet flat on the floor, and your torso stacked tall over your hips. | Hold a filled water bottle against your chest with both hands, hugging it close so the load stays centered over your body. | Brace your core, tuck your ribs down, and squeeze your glutes to set a neutral, upright spine. | Sit your hips back and down toward your heels under control, keeping your chest tall and your back flat. | Lower until your glutes lightly touch or hover just above your heels, keeping the bottle pinned to your chest. | Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the tall kneeling position, finishing with your hips fully extended. | Pause for a beat at the top without leaning back or arching your lower back. | Complete your reps, then set the bottle aside and rest back onto your heels.

t: Fill two water bottles to a matching, manageable weight and hold one in each hand with a neutral grip, arms hanging at your sides. | Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and your core braced. | Keep a slight bend in your elbows and let the bottles rest just in front of your thighs. | Raise both bottles out to your sides in a smooth arc, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Stop when your arms reach roughly shoulder height and the bottles are level with your shoulders. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping your wrists neutral and your shoulders down away from your ears. | Lower the bottles under control back to your sides without letting them swing. | Complete your reps, then set the bottles down safely.

tHe: Fill two water bottles to a matching, manageable weight and hold one in each hand with a neutral grip, arms hanging at your sides. | עמוד זקוף עם רגליים בערך ברוחב הכתפיים, ברכיים רכות, והליבה מכווצת. | Keep a slight bend in your elbows and let the bottles rest just in front of your thighs. | Raise both bottles out to your sides in a smooth arc, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Stop when your arms reach roughly shoulder height and the bottles are level with your shoulders. | עצור קצרות למעלה, תוך שמירה על שורשי כף יד ניטרליים והכתפיים למטה הרחק מהאוזניים. | Lower the bottles under control back to your sides without letting them swing. | סיים את החזרות, ואז הנח את הבקבוקים בבטחה.

t: Fill two bottles to an equal, matching weight and lie flat on your back on the floor or a bench, knees bent and feet planted. | Hold a bottle in each hand at chest level, palms facing toward your feet and elbows resting at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and together against the floor or bench. | Press both bottles straight up over your chest until your arms are fully extended, keeping the bottles roughly above your shoulders. | Pause briefly at the top with your chest squeezed and your wrists stacked over your elbows. | Lower the bottles under control back toward chest level, keeping your elbows at the same 45° angle. | Stop when your upper arms reach the floor or your chest, then press up again for your next rep. | Finish your set and set the bottles down beside you with control.

t: Lie on your back on the floor or a mat with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. | Hold a filled water bottle in both hands and press your arms straight up, then extend them back so the bottle sits above and slightly behind your head. | Keep your arms locked next to your ears and brace your core, pulling your ribs gently toward your hips. | Exhale and curl your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor, keeping the bottle fixed overhead rather than swinging it forward. | Crunch up until your shoulder blades clear the floor and you feel your abs fully shorten. | Pause for a moment at the top while keeping the bottle steady over your face. | Inhale and lower your torso back down under control until your shoulder blades touch the floor. | Complete your reps, then bring the bottle down to your chest and set it aside.

nR: Разгибания на трицепс над головой с бутылками
nH: פשיטות יד אחורית מעל הראש עם בקבוקים
t: Stand or sit tall with your feet about hip-width apart, core braced and ribs down. | Hold a filled water bottle vertically with both hands cupped under the top end, and press it straight overhead until your arms are fully extended. | Keep your elbows pointing up toward the ceiling and tucked in close to your head, not flaring out to the sides. | Bend at the elbows to lower the bottle slowly behind your head until you feel a stretch in your triceps. | Keep your upper arms still and vertical throughout, so only your forearms move. | Press the bottle back up by extending your elbows until your arms lock out overhead. | Complete your reps, then lower the bottle under control and set it down.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your feet about hip-width apart, core braced and ribs down. | Hold a filled water bottle vertically with both hands cupped under the top end, and press it straight overhead until your arms are fully extended. | Keep your elbows pointing up toward the ceiling and tucked in close to your head, not flaring out to the sides. | Согните руки в локтях и медленно опустите бутылку за голову, пока не почувствуете растяжение в трицепсах. | Keep your upper arms still and vertical throughout, so only your forearms move. | Press the bottle back up by extending your elbows until your arms lock out overhead. | Выполните все повторения, затем плавно опустите бутылку и положите её.

t: Fill a sturdy water bottle to a weight you can control and grip it firmly with both hands, cupping one end so it sits securely against your palms. | Lie back on a flat bench with your feet planted on the floor and your shoulder blades supported on the bench. | Press the bottle straight up over your chest with your arms nearly straight, keeping a slight, fixed bend in your elbows. | Brace your core and lower the bottle in a slow arc back over your head until you feel a stretch through your lats and chest. | Keep your arms in that same slightly bent position throughout — don't let your elbows bend further to turn it into a press. | Pull the bottle back over your chest by driving through your lats, returning to the start position with control. | Complete your reps, then bring the bottle back to your chest and set it down safely.

t: Hold a filled water bottle in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides, palms facing your body. | Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, shoulders back, and core braced. | Take a controlled step straight back with one foot, landing on the ball of that foot with your heel raised. | Lower your hips until both knees are bent to roughly 90 degrees, keeping your front shin close to vertical and your torso upright. | Keep most of your weight on the front foot and stop just before the back knee touches the floor. | Drive through the heel of your front foot to push back up to standing, bringing the rear foot forward to meet the other. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch legs, or alternate legs each rep. | Set the bottles down with control once the set is finished.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly soft. | Hold a filled water bottle in each hand (or one bottle in both hands) with an overhand, pronated grip so your knuckles face forward and your palms face your body. | Let your arms hang straight down at your sides with your elbows tucked close to your torso. | Keeping your upper arms still, curl the bottle upward by bending at the elbow until your forearms are roughly parallel with the floor. | Squeeze the top of your forearm at the top of the movement, keeping your wrists straight and firm. | Lower the bottle slowly and under control back to the starting position, resisting the weight on the way down. | Complete your reps, then set the bottle down with control.

nE: Bottle Weighted Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
nR: Концентрированные сгибания обратным хватом с бутылками
nH: כפיפות ריכוז באחיזה הפוכה עם בקבוקים
t: Sit on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and lean forward slightly from the hips. | Hold a filled water bottle in one hand with an overhand, reverse grip so your palm faces down and away from you. | Brace the back of your working upper arm against the inside of your thigh, just above the knee, so the elbow is fixed. | Let the bottle hang down with your arm fully extended, keeping your wrist firm and neutral. | Curl the bottle upward by bending only at the elbow, keeping your knuckles leading the way and your upper arm pinned to your thigh. | Squeeze the top of your forearm at the peak, then lower the bottle under control back to full extension. | Complete your reps, switch the bottle to the other hand, and repeat for an equal number of reps.
tRu: Sit on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and lean forward slightly from the hips. | Hold a filled water bottle in one hand with an overhand, reverse grip so your palm faces down and away from you. | Упритесь задней поверхностью рабочего плеча во внутреннюю сторону бедра чуть выше колена, чтобы зафиксировать локоть. | Let the bottle hang down with your arm fully extended, keeping your wrist firm and neutral. | Поднимите бутылку вверх, сгибая только локоть, ведя кулаками и удерживая верхнюю руку прижатой к бедру. | Squeeze the top of your forearm at the peak, then lower the bottle under control back to full extension. | Выполните все повторения, поменяйте бутылку на другую руку и повторите для равного количества повторений.
tHe: Sit on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and lean forward slightly from the hips. | Hold a filled water bottle in one hand with an overhand, reverse grip so your palm faces down and away from you. | הצמד את גב הזרוע העליונה של יד העבודה לצד הפנימי של הירך, ממש מעל הברך, כך שהמרפק מקובע. | Let the bottle hang down with your arm fully extended, keeping your wrist firm and neutral. | Curl the bottle upward by bending only at the elbow, keeping your knuckles leading the way and your upper arm pinned to your thigh. | Squeeze the top of your forearm at the peak, then lower the bottle under control back to full extension. | Complete your reps, switch the bottle to the other hand, and repeat for an equal number of reps.

t: Hold a filled water bottle in each hand (or one bottle in both hands) and stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart. | Let the bottles hang in front of your thighs with your arms straight, and pull your shoulders back and down. | Brace your core, soften your knees slightly, and keep this knee angle fixed for the rest of the rep. | Hinge at your hips by pushing your glutes straight back, lowering the bottles down the front of your legs. | Keep your back flat and the bottles close to your shins as you descend until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings. | Stop lowering once your back is about parallel to the floor or your hamstring flexibility runs out — do not round your lower back. | Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand back up to the starting position. | Complete your reps, then set the bottles down with a flat back.

t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet either flat on the ground or lifted a few inches for more challenge. | Hold a filled water bottle with both hands in front of your chest and lean your torso back to roughly 45 degrees, keeping your spine long. | Brace your core and pull your shoulders down, holding this leaned-back position throughout the set. | Rotate your torso to one side, moving the bottle toward the floor beside your hip while your eyes and chest follow the bottle. | Pause briefly when the bottle is beside your hip, keeping the movement controlled rather than swinging. | Rotate back through the center and twist to the opposite side, bringing the bottle down beside the other hip. | Continue alternating sides at a steady tempo, breathing out as you rotate and counting each side as one rep. | Finish your reps, then sit upright and set the bottle down with control.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, palms pressed down into the floor for stability. | Brace your core and raise your legs until they point straight up toward the ceiling, keeping them roughly vertical. | Press your palms into the floor and curl your pelvis off the mat, lifting your hips straight up toward the ceiling. | Drive through your lower abs so your feet travel upward, keeping the movement controlled rather than swinging your legs. | Pause briefly at the top with your hips lifted and your lower abs fully contracted. | Lower your hips back down to the mat slowly and under control, resisting on the way down. | Repeat for your target reps without letting your legs drift or your lower back arch off the floor.

t: Lie face-down on your mat with your legs together and your arms resting alongside your torso, forehead lightly on the floor. | Bend both knees and bring your heels toward your glutes, keeping your knees roughly hip-width apart. | Reach back with both hands and take hold of the outside of your ankles or the tops of your feet. | Inhale and press your shins back into your hands, using that resistance to lift your thighs, chest, and head away from the floor. | Draw your shoulder blades down and together to open the chest, keeping your gaze forward and your neck long. | Hold the pose and breathe steadily for 15–30 seconds, letting the lift come from the legs rather than from yanking with the arms. | To release, exhale and slowly lower your chest and thighs back to the floor under control. | Let go of your ankles, extend your legs, and rest with your head turned to one side before repeating.

t: Place a sturdy box or step beneath a pull-up bar so that, while standing on it, the bar is within easy overhead reach. | Step onto the box and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, thumbs wrapped around the bar. | Set your shoulders by pulling your shoulder blades down and back, and brace your core so your torso stays tight. | Bend your knees to take part of your weight onto your arms, keeping just enough foot pressure on the box to assist. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, leading with the lats rather than the arms. | Continue until your chin clears the bar, using only as much leg drive as you need to complete the rep. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended and your shoulders are set again. | Repeat for your target reps, then step down onto the box and release the bar safely.

t: Set a sturdy plyo box of low-to-moderate height (start around 12–18 in / 30–45 cm) on a firm, non-slip surface with clear space to land in front of it. | Stand on top of the box with your feet hip-width apart and your toes near the front edge. | Step off the box (do not jump up or out) and let yourself drop straight down toward the floor. | Land on the balls of both feet at the same time, with soft knees, hips back, and your weight balanced over your midfoot. | On contact, spend as little time on the ground as possible — minimize ground-contact time and reverse the momentum immediately. | Explode straight up into a maximal vertical jump, driving through your legs and swinging your arms upward. | Land softly from the jump with bent knees to absorb the force, then step back up onto the box and reset before the next rep.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Raise your hands into a loose boxing guard with your elbows tucked and shoulders relaxed. | Begin a light bounce, springing gently off the balls of your feet so your heels stay just off the floor. | Shift your weight rhythmically from one foot to the other, letting your hips sway naturally with the bounce. | Keep the movement small and quick, staying on your toes and breathing in a steady, relaxed rhythm. | Maintain a tall, upright torso and let your arms stay loose, bobbing slightly with the tempo. | Continue shuffling for your chosen interval, then gradually slow the bounce and step down to a flat-footed stance to cool down.

t: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward, feet about shoulder-width apart, knees softly bent, and weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Tuck your chin down toward your chest and bring both hands up so your gloves sit beside your cheekbones in a tight guard. | Keep your elbows pulled in close to your ribs to protect your body and your forearms vertical to cover your head. | As a punch comes in, raise your forearm and glove to meet it, absorbing the impact on your gloves or forearms rather than your head. | Stay light on your feet, making small adjusting steps to keep your stance and balance as you block. | Reset your hands straight back to the guard position immediately after each block, without dropping them. | Continue blocking and shuffling for the full round, keeping your breathing steady and your core braced. | At the end of the round, lower your hands, relax your shoulders, and recover before the next set.

t: Stand in front of the heavy bag in a staggered boxing stance, lead foot forward and rear foot back, feet about shoulder-width apart. | Bend your knees slightly, keep your weight balanced over the balls of your feet, and raise both hands to guard your chin. | Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked toward your ribs. | Extend your lead hand straight toward the bag, rotating your fist so the palm faces down at full extension. | Drive the punch by turning your lead shoulder and hip forward, keeping your rear hand up to protect your face. | Make contact with the front of your knuckles, keeping the wrist firm and aligned with the forearm. | Snap the lead hand straight back to your guard along the same line, without dropping it. | Reset your stance and repeat for the planned reps or round, then switch focus or rest.

t: Set up in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward, knees soft, and weight balanced on the balls of both feet. | Raise both hands to guard with your fists near your cheeks and your elbows tucked toward your ribs. | Have your partner hold a pad or focus mitt at face height as your target. | Snap your lead hand straight toward the pad, extending the arm fully while turning the fist over so the knuckles face forward at contact. | Add a small drive from the floor and a slight torso rotation so the punch comes from the body, not just the arm. | Retract the jab quickly along the same line, returning the hand straight back to guard. | Keep your rear hand up to protect your chin and your eyes on the target throughout. | Repeat for the prescribed time or rounds, staying light on your feet and breathing in rhythm with each punch.

t: Stand in an orthodox boxing stance with your left foot forward, knees soft, and weight balanced over the balls of your feet. Keep both hands up in guard. | Have your partner hold a focus mitt at chin-to-chest height, angled down toward you, and confirm the target and distance before throwing. | Dip slightly by bending your knees and shifting weight onto your lead (left) leg, keeping your back upright and core braced. | Drive explosively up through your left leg and hip, rotating your torso to the right to generate force. | Fire your left fist upward in a short arc, palm facing you, keeping the elbow bent at roughly 90 degrees so the punch travels straight up into the mitt. | Connect with the mitt at the top of the drive, exhaling sharply on impact and keeping your right hand up to protect your chin. | Snap the arm back down the same path and return to your guard, resetting your stance and balance. | Repeat for the prescribed reps or time, then switch roles or rest with your partner.

t: Stand in an orthodox boxing stance an arm's length from the bag: left foot forward, right foot back, feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft. | Raise both hands to guard with your fists by your cheeks, elbows tucked in, and chin slightly down. | Begin the punch by pivoting your right (rear) foot inward, lifting the heel and driving off the ball of the foot. | Rotate your right hip and shoulder toward the bag, transferring weight from your back leg onto your front leg. | Drive your right fist straight forward to the bag along a direct line, extending the arm fully as your shoulder turns. | Make contact with the front two knuckles, wrist straight and aligned with your forearm, just before the arm locks out. | Snap the punch back along the same line and return your right hand to guard, re-squaring your hips and feet. | Reset your stance and repeat for the prescribed time or reps, keeping a steady breathing rhythm throughout.

t: Start on the floor on your hands and knees with your hands stacked directly under your shoulders and your fingers spread for a stable base. | Straighten both arms fully so your elbows are locked but not hyperextended, and press the floor away to spread your shoulder blades. | Step your feet back one at a time until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels, resting on the balls of your feet. | Brace your abs as if bracing for a light punch, and squeeze your quads and glutes to keep your hips level with your shoulders. | Keep your neck long and your gaze just in front of your hands so your head stays in line with your spine. | Hold this position and breathe steadily, fighting any sag in the hips or rounding of the upper back. | Hold for your target time, then lower your knees to the floor under control to finish.

t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and a clear, flat landing path in front of you. | Hinge at the hips, bend your knees into a quarter squat, and swing your arms back to load. | Drive your arms forward and extend through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump as far forward as you can. | Spot your landing and touch down on the balls of both feet, sinking into a soft, athletic squat to absorb the impact. | As soon as you stick the landing, reverse direction without pausing and explode straight up into a maximal vertical jump. | Drive both arms overhead and reach as high as possible at the top of the vertical jump. | Land softly with bent knees, hips back, and your weight balanced over both feet. | Reset to a tall standing position, then repeat for the prescribed reps.

t: Stand a stride-length in front of a bench or box. Reach one foot back and rest the top of that foot on the surface so your front leg carries the load. | Set your front foot far enough forward that, at the bottom, your knee tracks over your mid-foot rather than far past your toes. Stand tall with your chest up and core braced. | Lower into a single-leg squat by bending the front knee and hip, sinking until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor. | Drive explosively through your front foot and extend your hip and knee to jump straight up off the floor. | Stay balanced in the air and keep your rear foot in light contact with the bench for support. | Land softly on the same front foot, letting your knee and hip bend to absorb the impact like a spring. | Sink straight into the next rep without pausing, keeping a steady rhythm for the set. | Complete all reps on one leg, then switch the front and rear feet and repeat on the other side.

t: Stand a stride's length in front of a sturdy chair, facing away from it. | Reach one foot back and rest the top of that foot (or the toes) on the chair seat. | Set your front foot far enough forward that your knee can track over your mid-foot when you descend; brace your core and keep your chest tall. | Lower yourself by bending the front knee and hip, dropping straight down until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor. | Keep most of your weight on the front foot and let the rear leg act mainly as a balance point. | Drive through the heel and mid-foot of your front leg to stand back up to the start position. | Complete all your reps on one side, then switch the rear foot and repeat on the other leg.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, chest up and arms relaxed at your sides. | Bend your knees and hips into a deep squat, lowering your hands to the floor in front of your feet. | Shift your weight onto your hands and kick both feet back, landing in a strong plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Keep your core braced and hips level for a moment, optionally lowering your chest toward the floor. | Jump or step both feet forward, landing them just outside your hands back in a deep squat position. | Drive through your heels and stand up tall to return to the starting position, keeping your chest lifted. | Reset your breathing and repeat for the prescribed reps or time, moving at a steady, controlled pace.

nE: Cable Front Squat with V bar
nR: Фронтальный присед на блоке с V-рукоятью
nH: סקוואט קדמי בכבלים עם מוט V

t: Set the pulley to the lowest position and clip on the rope attachment, then grip one end in each hand with a neutral (palms-facing) grip. | Step back to take the slack out of the cable and stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. | Brace your core, set your chest up, and let your arms hang straight so the rope rests in front of your thighs. | Pull the rope straight up toward your collarbones, leading with your elbows and driving them high and out to the sides. | Continue until your elbows are at or slightly above shoulder height and the rope is near the top of your chest. | Pause briefly and squeeze your shoulders and upper back at the top without shrugging into your neck. | Lower the rope under control back to the starting position, keeping tension on the cable the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then step in to relieve the tension before unclipping the rope.

nE: Cable High Row with Chest Support
nR: Высокая тяга с упором грудью на блоке
t: Set the cable pulley to a high position and attach the handle, then position a bench or chest pad so your torso is supported when leaning into it. | Sit or kneel facing the machine and rest your chest firmly against the pad, keeping your spine neutral and your head in line with your torso. | Reach up and grip the handle with both hands, arms fully extended, allowing the cable to lengthen and your shoulder blades to spread apart. | Brace your core and pull the handle down and back toward your upper torso, leading with your elbows. | Drive your elbows down and behind you while squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull. | Pause briefly in the contracted position without shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears. | Slowly return the handle to the start under control, letting your shoulder blades stretch forward again. | Complete your reps, then let the weight stack settle gently before releasing the handle.

t: Attach a neutral-grip (parallel) handle to the high pulley and set the thigh pad so your legs are anchored snugly under it. | Stand up, take a shoulder-width grip with palms facing each other, then sit down so your arms are fully extended overhead and the cable is under tension. | Set your torso upright with a slight backward lean, brace your core, and pull your shoulder blades down and back. | Drive your elbows down and toward your ribs, pulling the handle to the top of your chest while keeping your chest tall. | Squeeze your back at the bottom for a brief moment without shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears. | Control the handle back up until your arms are fully extended and you feel a stretch across your back. | Complete your reps, then guide the handle back to the pulley under control before standing up.

nH: לחיצת פאלוף עם גשר עכוז בכבלים
t: Set a cable pulley to about chest height and attach a single handle. | Lie on your back in front of the machine with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned so the cable runs across your body to one side. | Grip the handle with both hands and draw it in against the center of your chest, taking up the slack in the cable. | Brace your core, then drive through your heels to lift your hips into a glute bridge until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Holding the bridge, press the handle straight out in front of your chest until your arms are fully extended, resisting the cable's pull to one side. | Pause briefly with arms extended, keeping your hips level and your torso square. | Pull the handle back to your chest under control without letting your torso rotate. | Complete your reps, lower your hips to the floor, then switch sides and repeat with the cable pulling from the opposite direction.
tRu: Установите блок троса примерно на высоту груди и прикрепите одинарную рукоять. | Lie on your back in front of the machine with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned so the cable runs across your body to one side. | Grip the handle with both hands and draw it in against the center of your chest, taking up the slack in the cable. | Напрягите корпус, затем выжмите через пятки, чтобы поднять бёдра в мостик до прямого положения тела от плеч до колен. | Holding the bridge, press the handle straight out in front of your chest until your arms are fully extended, resisting the cable's pull to one side. | Pause briefly with arms extended, keeping your hips level and your torso square. | Pull the handle back to your chest under control without letting your torso rotate. | Выполните все повторения, опустите бёдра на пол, затем поменяйте сторону и повторите, тягу от блока выполняя в противоположном направлении.
tHe: כוון את גלגלת הכבל בערך לגובה החזה וחבר ידית אחת. | Lie on your back in front of the machine with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned so the cable runs across your body to one side. | Grip the handle with both hands and draw it in against the center of your chest, taking up the slack in the cable. | כווץ את שרירי הליבה, ואז דחוף את האגן התחתון מהרצפה עד שהגוף שלך יוצר קו ישר מהראש לעקבים. | Holding the bridge, press the handle straight out in front of your chest until your arms are fully extended, resisting the cable's pull to one side. | Pause briefly with arms extended, keeping your hips level and your torso square. | Pull the handle back to your chest under control without letting your torso rotate. | Complete your reps, lower your hips to the floor, then switch sides and repeat with the cable pulling from the opposite direction.

nR: Тяга сверху параллельным хватом с пола на блоке
